jobs.title: Asset/Move Coordinator I (Relocation Project Coordinator)
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Join Our Team**

Project Support Services (PSS) is seeking an organized, detail-oriented Asset/Move Coordinator I to support the Los Angeles Community College District’s BuildLACCD program. This position assists with furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FF&E) coordination and campus relocations for new buildings, renovated facilities, and temporary swing spaces.

The ideal candidate brings experience in relocation coordination, interior design, construction, facilities, or FF&E procurement and enjoys coordinating the details that help campus teams move into functional, ready-to-use spaces.

**Position Overview**

Working with the Relocation Project Management (RPM) team, the Asset/Move Coordinator I supports FF&E planning, procurement, budget and schedule tracking, deliveries, installation, and move coordination across multiple LACCD campuses.

Under the direction of the College Project Director and RPM leadership, this position coordinates with campus representatives, project teams, designers, vendors, and movers throughout pre-move planning, installation, relocation, and closeout.

Assignments may include campuses within the Valleyside group—Los Angeles Valley College, Los Angeles Mission College, and Los Angeles Pierce College—and/or the Cityside group—Los Angeles City College, Los Angeles Trade-Technical College, and East Los Angeles College/South Gate. The position requires onsite availability, reliable transportation between assigned locations, and schedule flexibility.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support FF&E selection, programming, specifications, procurement coordination, purchasing, and installation for new, renovated, and swing space projects.
* Assist with FF&E purchasing through best-value and/or low-bid public contracting processes.
* Coordinate with architects, interior designers, Project Managers, and campus user groups to identify furniture and equipment requirements.
* Assist with office layouts and plans for relocating existing furniture and equipment to new spaces.
* Prepare and maintain lists of new furniture and equipment needed for assigned projects, identifying gaps and coordinating with vendors or movers.
* Track FF&E and relocation budgets, schedules, purchases, deliveries, and installation activities.
* Support move planning, including scope development, bidding, bid analysis, scheduling, and onsite coordination.
* Prepare detailed scopes of work for task orders involving movers and specialty contractors supporting delivery, installation, or equipment connections.
* Coordinate furniture and equipment deliveries with project teams, campus facilities personnel, and building occupants.
* Assist with onsite FF&E installation, move oversight, punch list completion, and transition into occupied spaces.
* Coordinate access to project areas during pre-move, installation, move, and closeout activities, including unlocking and securing spaces as needed.
* Work with the Asset Management Team to coordinate asset tagging and disposition requirements.
* Coordinate with warranty personnel and other program staff to support project closeout.
* Maintain organized FF&E, moving, and storage records, including proposals, purchase orders, packing slips, time cards, shipping documents, freight bills, and invoices.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* At least one year of related experience in interior design, construction, engineering, moves/relocations, facilities, or FF&E coordination/procurement.
* High school diploma.
* Ability to read architectural and furniture drawings.
* Knowledge of furniture and equipment specifications and procurement.
* Strong written and verbal communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and related word processing, spreadsheet, and database software.
* Ability to work onsite at multiple colleges.
* Schedule flexibility and transportation to work at multiple locations based on project assignments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Four-year degree in Architecture, Interior Architecture, Interior Design, Construction/Project Management, Facilities Management, or a related field.
* Experience in procurement, sourcing, or asset management.
* Public works experience.
* Knowledge of or proficiency in AutoCAD.
* Relevant certification or professional membership associated with CID, IIDA, AIA, IFMA, or LEED.

**Apply**

Submit your resume highlighting your experience in FF&E coordination, procurement, facilities, or relocation projects, including any experience supporting educational facilities or public works programs.

Pay: $82,000.00 - $93,500.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you have 1 year of related experience in Interior Design, Construction, Engineering, Moves/Relocations, Facilities, or Furniture, Fixture and Equipment coordination/procurement?
* Do you have a high school diploma?
* Do you have knowledge of furniture and equipment specifications and procurement, as well as the ability to read architectural and furniture drawings?
* Do you have public works experience?
* Do you have procurement, sourcing or asset management experience?
* Do you have certification/membership with CID, IIDA, AIA, IFMA, LEED?
* Do you have proficiency in Microsoft Office and related word processing, spreadsheet, and database software?
* Do you have a four-year degree in the areas of Architecture, Interior Architecture, Interior Design, Construction/Project Management, Facilities Management or related area required?

Ability to Commute:

* Los Angeles, CA 90017 (Required)

Work Location: In person

**Position Location:** New York, NY or Los Angeles, CA

**Start Date:** Immediate

**About:** The Premier Lacrosse League (PLL) is a professional lacrosse league in North America, composed of 8 teams rostered with the best players in the world. Co-founded by lacrosse superstar Paul Rabil and his brother, serial entrepreneur and investor, Mike Rabil, the Premier Lacrosse League is backed by an investment group composed of Joe Tsai Sports, The Raine Group, Creative Artists Agency (CAA), and other top investors in sports and media. The PLL is distributed through an exclusive media rights agreement with ABC, ESPN, ESPN2, and ESPN+. For more information, visit www.premierlacrosseleague.com and follow on social media: Instagram (@PLL), Twitter (@PremierLacrosse), Facebook (@PremierLacrosseLeague) and YouTube (YouTube.com/PLL).

**Company Values:**

* Stay Grounded
* Think Critically
* Be Helpful
* Encourage Creativity
* Persevere Through the Noise
* Operate Like an Owner

**Position Overview**:

The PLL is seeking a creative and strategic Social Media Coordinator who excels at building authentic connections with audiences across digital platforms. This role is responsible for developing engaging content, managing community interactions, and amplifying the PLL brand voice across all social channels.

The ideal candidate will serve as the digital voice for a PLL Team, creating thumb-stopping content that resonates with both lifelong lacrosse fans and newcomers to the sport. You'll collaborate with various departments of the league to develop compelling visual stories, timely reactive content, and innovative campaigns that drive engagement and grow our community.

This position requires a deep understanding of social media trends, platform-specific best practices, and the ability to adapt tone and style across multiple channels. You'll monitor the PLL online ecosystem, engage authentically with fans, handle community management, and identify opportunities to join relevant conversations that elevate the league's presence.

* Minimum 3 years experience managing social media for a brand, sports team, or organization

* Strong proficiency across Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X, Facebook, YouTube, and emerging platforms

* Basic graphic design skills using Canva, Adobe Express, or similar platforms
* Exceptional copywriting abilities with platform-specific expertise and strong attention to detail
* Experience creating TikToks, Instagram Reels, Stories, and other short-form vertical content

* Understanding of lacrosse (rules, players, teams) or strong willingness to learn quickly
* Passion for sports with ability to create content for both dedicated fans and casual audiences
* Self-motivated with excellent organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and maintain composure under pressure
* Strong collaboration and communication skills with creative and cross-functional teams
* Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings and weekends, and travel for games and events as required by business needs, with or without reasonable accommodation

**Compensation:**

* $66,000-$72,000 annually
* Based on the candidate’s experience, seniority, and location
The total compensation package includes Annual Bonus, Health, Life, Dental, and Vision Insurance, 401(k) plan, Equity Sharing, Unlimited PTO, and Paid Parental Leave

* **Travel and Glam Logistics:** Support talent travel and glam, working with talent reps, as well as the travel agency, car service and glam artists/their reps.
* **Press Materials and Assets:** Coordinate and help in drafting press materials, including weekly and monthly programming blasts, synopses, lead releases, cast bios and credits. Assist with digital asset selection and distribution. Work with publicists to keep present current for all campaigns.

* Bachelor’s degree in Public Relations, Communications, Journalism, or comparable work experience.
* Strong judgment in maintaining confidentiality of unannounced projects, talent relationships and other sensitive and proprietary information.
* Proficiency in using Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Sharepoint, etc.), Microsoft Teams and Zoom.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Highly organized with the ability to anticipate, prioritize and manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Availability for some travel and after-hours support as-needed.

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience using media databases (e.g., Muck Rack, Cision), press sites and release-distribution tools.
* Knowledge of the Hallmark brand and Hallmark Media platforms, or other family-friendly entertainment.

jobs.title: Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

FNTECH has been producing standout events since 1998, from global conferences and trade shows to hackathons, roadshows and leadership summits for both well-established and up-and-coming brands and companies. We’re a one-stop shop for Production, Event Management and Creative Design, and we bring the same drive for excellence and people-first approach to everything we do – our clients, our vendors and each other.

We are seeking an experienced Event Coordinator to support a team of four to six event managers in all aspects of Event Management. This role will have defined team responsibilities as well as growth opportunities, the option to impact company processes, to develop and maintain best practices, and support the development of our proprietary Show Management software system.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, deadline focused, and experienced in understanding complex planning. This person must be a confident and professional communicator who can interact effectively with internal teams and clients while maintaining strong collaboration with vendors, venue staff, and on-site operational teams. When things move fast, we’ll bring calm, not chaos.

This position requires the following skills and abilities:

● Excellent project management, organizational, and communication skills.

● Ability to manage multiple workstreams and complex timelines from start to finish.

● Understand how decisions relate to and affect various downstream event plans and activities.

● Flexibility to pivot quickly when ideas and plans change, which they always will.

● A thoughtful “solutions-first” mindset when challenges arise.

● Stay on schedule and meet established deadlines.

● Attention to detail that creates consistency between documents, software, and all communication tools.

● Striving for innovation and continuous quality improvement in processes, events, relationships, etc.

● Comfort working in various settings including the warehouse, office, offsite, office, show floor, etc. and in any weather conditions.

● Calm and composure under pressure during live production environments.

● Bonus: a creative and design-minded eye.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Department Support**

● Coordinate the ordering and management of company promotional products and branded apparel.

● Maintain inventory of branded assets.

● Support administrative functions that improve efficiency and organization including managing schedules and aligning priorities across projects, teams, and vendors.

● Support cross departmental collaboration with internal teams.

● Maintain stellar external relationships with vendors and production partners.

● Manage company’s Environmental inventory (see below for more details)

● Ensure the team's onsite event supply boxes are fully stocked as well as cross-referenced with specific orders and packing lists for each event.

**Environmental Inventory**

● Manage and maintain our Environmental (Furniture and Décor) department including lookbook, inventory, pricing, new purchases and warehousing.

● Partner with leadership and the Event Management team to plan and manage the Environmental inventory budget, and coordinate the purchasing, tracking and maintenance of related company assets.

● Work closely with the warehouse team on event deadlines pertaining to logistics, ensure information is being communicated between the Event Management Team and Warehouse.

● Ensure damaged items are repaired and graphics are removed prior to being stored.

● Continue to foster relationships with current vendors and discover new potential vendors.

**Specific Event Support**

Work closely with the Event Managers to:

● Act as the main liaison with venues to gather all guidelines and documentation, be the source of venue information for the internal team.

● Apply and obtain permits, submit COI requirements and venue orders, and cross-check against Proformas for company and client budgets.

● Schedule weekly meetings, gather and maintain agendas, keep meeting notes, review weekly deadlines, and organize notes for client and internal teams.

● Assist in managing logistics including workback plans, onsite production schedules, event agendas, shipping timelines, staffing schedules, and post event storage and product distribution.

● Support onsite event set-up and dismantle that may include specific activations, production office support, specific staffing areas, etc.

● Provide post-event feedback for venue, client and internal teams.

Additional Event Planning Team Support:

● Help identify and secure venues for clients by creating Requests for Proposals, managing and comparing responses, organizing site visits, and negotiating contracts.

● Assist in creating attendee journey mapping and space planning for every part of the program including main venue, ancillary and evening events, breakout functions, and offsite activities.

● Learn every part of the event lifecycle: catering, staffing, promo, registration, venue liaison, security, environmental, logistics, layouts, budget, attendee journey, graphics, workbacks & schedules, etc.

● The Event Coordinator and Sponsor & Logistics Coordinator work hand in hand, where each role strengthens the other to keep projects moving and on track.

● Travel to domestic and international shows as needed (valid passport required).

**Required Qualifications**

● Bachelor’s degree in Event Management, Marketing, Communications, or related field.

● 1-3+ years of experience in corporate or agency event management.

● Demonstrated team experience producing small to large-scale events, product launches, or technology industry events with a greater team.

● Strong client-facing experience with the ability to manage high-profile stakeholders.

● Experience with multiple communication technology and video conferencing platforms.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance

jobs.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

Asset Living is a third-party management firm and a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single-family home rentals, affordable housing, build-to-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.

  

Asset Living is a fast-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed’. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.

  

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.

**ASSISTANT COMMUNITY MANAGER**

The Assistant Community Manager is responsible for overseeing, under the supervision of the Community Manager, the everyday operations and financial functions of the housing community. As the Assistant Community Manager, you will play a vital role in the delinquency and collection of rent to optimize the property's cash flow and financial position. As an Assistant Community Manager, you will manage all phases of the operations, including personnel, leasing, maintenance, financial, administration & risk management in the absence of the Community Manager. As an onsite leader, you will supervise all aspects of the property and staff to ensure compliance with the company's policies and procedures, safety and fair housing guidelines, and liability concerns.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

Financial Management

* Responsible for posting all payments and income received from all applicants, current residents, and non-current residents accurately, timely, and efficiently.
* Responsible for processing and reconciling daily all account receivables.
* Monitor and follow up on bad debt to include preparation of late notices, resident and guarantor contact, and filing evictions.
* Responsible for helping the property meet budgeted revenues, expenses, and Net Operating Income.
* Responsible for posting of all charges to resident and non-current resident accounts; to also include bill back of utilities where applicable.
* Responsible for all end-of-the-month closing procedures and reporting.
* Maintain accurate and organized records; audit resident files to ensure accurate records.
* Responsible for walking units and posting all move-out charges, statements, and security deposit refunds.

Personnel Management

* Regular/daily onsite attendance is required
* Use consistent techniques & company directives to screen, hire, train, coach, and develop onsite staff.
* Ensure the effectiveness of staff through ongoing training, coaching, counseling, and guidance in compliance with Asset training benchmarks.
* Promote harmony and quality job performance of staff through support and effective leadership.
* Ensure staff compliance and consistency with Company policies and procedures.
* Strategic Leasing Management
* Ensure staff leasing techniques are effective in obtaining closure, follow-up procedures met, signing/documentation of leases, and reporting systems are accurate and up to date.
* Implement marketing strategies & systems put in place by the annual marketing plan.
* Deal with resident complaints, concerns, and requests to ensure resident satisfaction.
* Develop and implement resident retention programs (i.e., resident functions, special promotions, monthly newsletter, etc.)
* Effectively show, lease, and move in prospective residents.

Administrative Management

* Manage excellent customer service and monitor service request turnaround and responsiveness of maintenance staff.
* Maintain property appearance and ensure repairs are noted and completed on a timely basis (this requires regular property inspections and tours)
* Assist with supervision of all business functions related to operations.
* Plan for and utilize property resources, equipment, and supplies economically (i.e., obtaining bids/pricing from vendors, suppliers, contractors, dealing with inadequate service, etc.)

**Education/Experience**

* High School Diploma or Equivalent; Bachelor’s degree preferred or two years experience in the housing industry; or one to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Ability to understand and perform all onsite software functions; basic computer skills required.

### **Description**

**THE PURPOSE:** The Social Media + Community Manager brings True Religion’s brand to life through compelling social content and meaningful community connections, both online and IRL. Reporting to the Director, Social Media, this role balances two equally important responsibilities: managing day-to-day social planning, content briefing, publishing, and performance reporting; and building an engaged community through conversation, relationship-building, and social listening. Working closely with the content creator and cross-functional partners, this person translates social strategy into a consistent, culturally relevant presence that grows awareness, engagement, advocacy, and traffic to TrueReligion.com and stores.

### **THE ROLE (what you are accountable for):**

**SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGEMENT**

* Own the day-to-day social content calendar, translating the Director’s strategy into monthly plans and weekly publishing schedules across Instagram, TikTok, and other priority channels. Balance campaigns, product storytelling, cultural moments, and community-led content.
* Manage scheduling and publishing across native platforms and social management tools. Coordinate assets, approvals, deadlines, and calendar changes with Creative, PR, Influencer Marketing, Ecommerce, and Retail partners.
* Develop clear content briefs for creative partners, outlining the objective, audience, key message, platform, format, hook, deliverables, and timing. Provide feedback and coordinate revisions to keep work on brief.
* Write and adapt captions, copy, calls to action, and platform-specific messaging in the brand voice. Check final assets, tags, links, product details, inventory, and approvals before publishing.
* Partner with the content creator on platform-native ideas, trend-driven content, and real-time coverage of launches and events
* Monitor post performance and recommend improvements to content mix, formats, hooks, posting cadence, and timing. Maintain an organized asset library and accurate calendar and publishing records.
* Deliver weekly social performance reporting, including reach, views, engagement rate, shares, saves, follower growth, and attributable traffic. Connect results to objectives, highlight top and underperforming content, and recommend specific actions and tests.

**COMMUNITY MANAGEMENT**

* Own daily community management across priority social channels, responding to comments, direct messages, mentions, and tags with timely, thoughtful, on-brand replies.
* Proactively join relevant conversations and engage with fans, creators, and cultural communities to strengthen relationships, encourage participation, and grow brand advocacy.
* Maintain community guidelines, response playbooks, and escalation workflows with the Director. Flag sensitive conversations and potential reputation issues promptly, coordinating responses with PR and Customer Service.
* Partner with Customer Service to optimize consumer journey across priority channels.
* Monitor brand and competitor conversations, audience sentiment, and fashion, music, and cultural trends. Turn recurring questions, feedback, and emerging conversations into content and campaign recommendations.
* Plan and execute community engagement initiatives, including prompts, polls, giveaways, challenges, and live conversations, coordinating approvals, logistics, and follow-up with relevant partners.
* Include community health in weekly reporting: sentiment, recurring questions, and engagement initiative results. Share actionable audience insights and track follow-through.

**YOU ARE:**

You are equal parts organized social operator and thoughtful community builder. You can turn a strategy into an actionable calendar, write a clear brief, and keep content moving from concept to publication. You understand how fashion, music, and culture intersect, bring a sharp instinct for brand voice, and know how to make audiences feel heard. You pair creative judgment with data, stay calm when conversations become sensitive, and take ownership of details, deadlines, and recommendations in a fast-paced environment.

  

### **REQUIRED MINIMUM EXPERIENCE**

  

* 3-5+ years of experience in social media management, including hands-on ownership of both content calendars/publishing and community engagement, ideally for a consumer brand
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Deep knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, and other major social platforms, including platform-native storytelling, publishing workflows, and audience behavior
* Excellent writing and content briefing skills, with the ability to adapt brand voice across captions, creative briefs, and community conversations
* Experience managing comments, direct messages, and escalations, including handling negative feedback and sensitive issues with good judgment
* Hands-on experience with social media management and listening tools, such as Sprout Social, Hootsuite, or Brandwatch
* Strong analytical skills, with experience producing weekly social and community reports and translating performance data into clear recommendations
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to coordinate calendars, assets, approvals, and competing deadlines while responding to timely community needs

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

* Experience in fashion, apparel, or streetwear
* Experience collaborating with content creators, creative teams, and influencer programs, including sourcing UGC and coordinating usage permissions
* Basic photo and video editing skills, using tools such as CapCut, Canva, or Adobe Creative Suite

  

### **ADDITIONAL ROLE INFORMATION**

**Salary:** $75,000 – $90,000 base, depending on experience

### **About eJam**

eJam is a privately held consumer products company that has built, scaled, and exited multiple brands. Our portfolio includes category leaders ranked at the top of Amazon, carried in major retailers nationwide, and sold across DTC, marketplaces, and every channel in between.

We’re not a startup hoping something works. We’re a team that has done it repeatedly: taken products from idea to category leader, landed them on retail shelves nationwide, and built real brands that consumers love. We operate like a holding company with the speed of a startup: small teams with real ownership and accountability.

This is the place where you’ll see the entire machine: sourcing, product development, packaging, manufacturing, compliance, marketing, marketplace strategy, retail, all under one roof. If you want to build and ship consumer products at scale, there is no better place than this.

### **The Role**

You will own the path from a customer order to recognized, reconciled revenue across every eJam channel, end to end. Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, QVC and retail each report revenue, refunds, fees and payouts differently, and you make them agree: one gross to net waterfall per brand, one daily revenue number the CEO, finance and media buyers all trust, and channel payouts that tie to the bank.

You will be the person who finds where the cash went missing, and the one who brings receivables management in house as we retire our outsourced A/R partner.

**Mission:** Finance and brand leadership know what we actually earned yesterday, by brand and channel, and every dollar between gross sales and the bank is explained, before they have to ask.

### **What You'll Own**

**Revenue data and reporting**

* Own the daily gross to net revenue report by brand and channel: gross sales, discounts, refunds, chargebacks, merchant and agency fees, sales tax and net revenue, and explain every movement
* Maintain the revenue layer of the BigQuery finance and goal pacing dashboards so the numbers the business runs on match what Accounting books
* Build and automate recurring revenue, subscription and channel performance reports, and replace manual spreadsheet pulls with repeatable queries
* Track subscription revenue health: rebill approval rates, declines, retries, churn and refund drivers, and flag what needs action

**Reconciliation and receivables**

* Reconcile Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop and payment processor payouts and settlements to the bank and the ledger each period, and chase every unexplained difference to its source
* Support the month end close with revenue, refund, chargeback and fee reconciliations, and the related journal entry support
* Manage retail and marketplace receivables (QVC, Target, Walmart, Kroger and the SAI portfolio as it moves in house): invoicing, remittance matching, deductions and short pays, and an aging the team acts on
* Own the sales tax data flow and marketplace facilitator treatment with our tax platform

**Process and systems**

* The order to cash process documented per channel, with control points and SOPs the team runs on, built with the data, subscription, customer support and media teams
* Recurring revenue reporting automated with Claude and documented so it survives a vacation

### **What Success Looks Like**

* **30 days:** the daily gross to net report publishes by brand without manual intervention and every channel's payout reconciliation is documented
* **90 days:** BigQuery revenue ties to QuickBooks Online for the prior month with a written bridge for every known difference, and retail and marketplace receivables aging is owned end to end
* **6 months:** order to cash SOPs exist for every channel, unreconciled revenue differences sit at zero at close, two recurring reports run materially faster, and the business trusts one revenue number

  
**Requirements**

**Required (all four, no exceptions)**

* **Order to cash:** tied Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, Stripe or similar settlements and payouts back to the general ledger and found a gap
* **Gross to net:** built a bridge from gross sales through discounts, refunds, chargebacks, fees and tax to net revenue, and explained what moved
* **Subscription:** worked rebill approval, decline, retry and churn data for a recurring revenue business
* **Receivables:** managed retail or marketplace A/R, including remittance matching, deductions and short pays, with an aging someone acted on

**Also required**

* 3 to 7 years in revenue operations, revenue accounting or finance operations, ideally at a DTC, subscription or ecommerce brand
* Advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, Power Query) and working SQL, BigQuery or another warehouse preferred, with dashboards in Looker Studio, Tableau or Power BI
* You use AI, primarily Claude, as a working tool every day, and you check its output before it goes anywhere
* Bachelor's in finance, accounting, economics, analytics or related

**Nice to have**

* QuickBooks Online or Ramp
* A subscription or order management stack
* Sales tax and marketplace facilitator mechanics (TaxJar, Numeral or Avalara)
* Amazon settlement reporting

  
**Benefits**  

### **Compensation**

jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Nitrogen Express is a family-owned industrial and specialty gas distribution business. We supply businesses that need gases and related products to keep their operations running. We earn revenue by selling and delivering products and by keeping customers invoiced, collected, and serviced reliably.

**About the Position**

We need one accountable, in-office owner for the company’s day-to-day financial administration and office operating rhythm. The work is important to cash flow, vendor relationships, customer experience, and good decision-making. We want to replace fragmented processes with reliable systems—not just fill a desk.

This is a high-visibility seat in a stable, family-owned business where a capable person can make a real difference. The person will not be stuck doing one narrow transaction all day. They will own meaningful financial workflows, work directly with the owner, improve how the business operates, and build systems that matter. It is an excellent opportunity for someone who is tired of being buried in a large company or limited to a narrow AP/AR silo and wants broader responsibility.

**Responsibilities**

This person should own the day-to-day financial workflows for a small operating business, with appropriate owner review and approval on major decisions and payments.

* Maintain clean, timely QuickBooks Online records and supporting documentation.
* Drive invoicing promptly and accurately; identify missing information before it creates a billing delay.
* Own the accounts-receivable rhythm: aging review, professional customer follow-up, notes, escalation, and collections follow-through.
* Organize accounts payable: receive and code bills, maintain vendor files, prepare a clear weekly payables list, and make sure nothing important is missed. Owner approval remains required for payments.
* Support bank and credit-card reconciliations, month-end readiness, and clear financial reporting for the owner and outside accounting support.
* Create, document, and maintain practical SOPs for invoicing, collections, payables, customer account setup, and file management.
* Use Excel, QuickBooks, and secure AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to reduce manual work, catch errors, create follow-up drafts, improve reporting, and make processes more reliable.
* Serve as a dependable, professional in-office point of contact for customers, vendors, and the team.

**First 30 / 60 / 90 days**

* Learn the business, customer/payment cycles, QuickBooks structure, vendors, and current workflow.
* Take control of the AR aging and open-payables visibility.
* Identify immediate invoicing, collections, and file-organization gaps.
* Establish a weekly owner-facing cash, receivables, and payables rhythm.

* Implement a consistent invoice-to-collection process and documented collection cadence.
* Clean up vendor, customer, and supporting-document workflows.
* Create clear SOPs for the highest-risk recurring tasks.
* Present the first practical automation / process-improvement recommendations.

* Deliver reliable recurring reporting to the owner.
* Show improved visibility into AR aging, invoicing status, and upcoming payables.
* Complete at least two meaningful workflow improvements that reduce manual rework or missed follow-up.
* Deliver a prioritized next-step plan for stronger controls, reporting, and sensible use of AI.

**What success looks like**

* Success is not just “the books are entered.” The right person makes the financial side of the business feel organized, current, and visible. Invoices go out on time, collections are handled professionally and consistently, vendor obligations are clear, records are easy to find, and the owner can see what needs attention without chasing information.

Qualifications

* At least 3 years of relevant hands-on accounting/finance-office experience.
* Recent hands-on experience with QuickBooks and the end-to-end cycle of invoicing, AR/collections, AP, vendor bills, and financial organization—not only one narrow task in a large department.
* QuickBooks Online, Excel, bank/credit-card reconciliation, billing, receivables, collections, payables, and basic reporting.
* Experience in a small owner-led B2B business such as distribution, industrial supply, logistics, field service, construction supply, equipment rental/repair, manufacturing support, or a similar operational environment.
* A practical, privacy-conscious use of AI and automation. The candidate should be able to name specific workflows improved with AI or automation and explain how they protected customer and financial information.
* Comfortable making courteous but firm collections calls and documenting commitments.
* A demonstrated record of identifying a problem, creating a usable process, following through, and communicating clearly with an owner, customers, vendors, and teammates.
* The person must want to work in the office five days per week and have a realistic commute.

No CPA or bachelor’s degree is required if the person can demonstrate the actual skills, judgment, and ownership required for the job. A bookkeeping or QuickBooks certification is a plus, not a substitute for proven work.

Compensation and Benefits

* $52,000–$58,000, depending on proven ownership of the full workflow and the ability to improve systems.

* Strong knowledge of oncology and knowledge of NETs products is preferred.

* Track record of proven sales success in consecutive years.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

This is a field based Sales/Account Management position requiring frequent travel, including some weekends, within an assigned territory.

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager (US)
jobs.description:
Easol is the leading all-in-one ‘experience commerce’ platform built to power experience businesses including festivals, wellness retreats, food and drink, sports and adventure trips. With Easol, experience businesses have complete control to drive more direct sales, retain more revenue, own their data and run their business on their terms.

Easol has deep roots in experiences. The platform was founded by former festival founders, Lisa and Ben Simpson in 2017, after the husband and wife team endured challenges and frustrations first-hand while setting up and growing their own experience business including Rise, Europe’s biggest Snowsports and music festival, and Beyond Adventures, a series of adventure travel experiences in remote locations such as the Sahara desert and the Swedish archipelago.

Easol is the first AI operating system for the Experience Commerce category - an intelligent digital workforce that helps experience creators run their business. Our ambition is bold: to become the category leader in a $300bn+ space.

We power professional experience creators with a fully integrated platform that brings together website, booking engine, payments, sales & marketing tools, operations, and data & insight - all underpinned by agentic AI. Easol enables enterprise creators to streamline, scale and transform their businesses through a single, end-to-end system.

Today, we focus on two core verticals: Music and Entertainment (LBE). Over the next year, we'll be deepening our product in each vertical and expanding into new segments.

We're a fast-growing, well-funded business that doubled in size in 2025, with a clear pathway to do the same again in 2026. A key pillar of our strategy is building AI-centric workflows directly into the platform, transforming how creators design, sell and operate their experiences.

### **Role Overview**

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will own the success and retention of a portfolio of Easol’s enterprise creators in the US.

You’ll build trusted relationships across each account, understand how their businesses operate, and help them get the most value from Easol across their customer journey — from complex implementations and major launches through ongoing account strategy, adoption and renewal.

This is a relationship-led role, but we are looking for someone who is also comfortable getting into the detail. You should be confident in managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders, troubleshooting platform or reporting issues, investigating data discrepancies, understanding setup and configuration, and working closely with Product, Engineering and Solutions when deeper technical support is required.

As Easol continues to develop as an AI-native platform, you'll also play a key role in helping creators understand, adopt and realise value from our AI products and capabilities, while advocating for their needs and helping shape the future of the platform.

Success in this role means your creators are successfully launched, retained, actively using Easol and view you as a trusted strategic partner who understands both their business and the platform.

### **Responsibilities & Duties**

* Own a portfolio of enterprise creators, building strong, multi-threaded relationships across operational and executive stakeholders, taking accountability for their overall success and retention, and proactively identifying and managing risks.
* Understand each creator's business model, priorities and goals, developing strategic account plans and leading QBRs and regular business reviews, using account health data and CS tooling to identify risks, opportunities and next steps.
* Lead complex implementations, major launches and creator initiatives, managing project timelines, dependencies, risks and stakeholder alignment across internal and external teams.
* Support creators through major on-sales and key trading periods, proactively coordinating internal teams to ensure successful delivery and resolve issues as they arise.
* Identify and surface expansion and cross-sell opportunities, partnering closely with Sales to progress them through strong customer relationships and commercial insight.
* Champion the adoption of Easol's AI products and capabilities, helping creators identify relevant use cases, understand their value and successfully integrate AI-powered workflows into their operations.
* Independently troubleshoot platform, reporting and configuration issues, using data, dashboards and exports to diagnose problems and provide creators with clear answers.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Solutions and Event Operations to resolve complex issues, providing clear context, coordinating specialist support and driving issues through to resolution.
* Act as the voice of the creator internally, translating feedback, operational challenges and business requirements into actionable product insights that help influence priorities and shape Easol's roadmap.
* Maintain strong product knowledge and advise creators on how to best use Easol's capabilities to improve their customer experience and operational performance.
* Represent Easol onsite at key creator events, launches and strategic meetings to strengthen relationships and support successful delivery.
* Contribute to the continued development of Easol's Customer Success approach, including account planning, processes, tooling, automation and scalable ways of working.

### **Requirements**

* **4+ years of experience** in Customer Success or Account Management within SaaS/B2B, with demonstrated experience independently owning and managing a portfolio of customers, including responsibility for account health, retention and long-term success.
* Experience leading complex implementations, launches or customer projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage timelines, dependencies, competing priorities and stakeholder expec

jobs.title: Marketing Social Channel and Community Manager
jobs.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

**The opportunity**
===================

Help shape how NiCE shows up, connects and participates on social.

We’re looking for a hands-on Social Channel & Community Manager to manage our global NiCE and NiCE Cognigy social presence, with a primary focus on LinkedIn and YouTube.

You’ll combine strong channel management with active listening, editorial judgment and community engagement. Working with our Global Social Lead and Social Content Creator, you’ll identify relevant conversations, bring forward content ideas and build an engaging daily presence for our brands.

**What you will do**
====================

* **Manage our channels.** Own day-to-day calendar coordination, scheduling, publishing and account management, tailoring execution to each channel’s audience and strategy.
* **Listen and identify opportunities.** Monitor audience conversations, industry developments and platform trends, translating insights into relevant post ideas and opportunities to participate.
* **Build community.** Engage with audiences on our channels and in relevant industry conversations, responding thoughtfully and escalating issues when needed.
* **Shape the editorial calendar.** Balance original engagement content, timely opportunities and priority brand and campaign initiatives.
* **Partner on content.** Work closely with our Social Content Creator to turn ideas and listening insights into compelling, channel-native content.
* **Collaborate across Marketing.** Partner with brand, communications, campaign, product marketing and regional teams to bring useful stories and perspectives to social.
* **Improve performance.** Track audience and content performance, share actionable insights and recommend changes to strengthen engagement and channel effectiveness.
* **Support advocacy.** Help executives, subject matter experts and employees participate through agreed social programs.

**What you bring**
==================

* 2-5 years of hands-on social media experience, including independent management of multiple brand channels, community engagement, social listening and performance optimization.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or related field or experience
* Strong experience with LinkedIn and YouTube, plus working knowledge of other major social platforms.
* Excellent writing and editorial judgment, with the ability to make complex topics accessible and engaging.
* A track record of translating audience insights and trends into relevant content opportunities.
* Experience with social publishing, listening and analytics tools.
* Strong organization, sound judgment and the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Experience in B2B technology or a similarly complex industry is strongly preferred.
* Ability to collaborate globally, including regular working-hour overlap with a Berlin-based manager.

**What success looks like**
===========================

Our channels run reliably, our audiences experience an active and responsive brand, and listening consistently informs what we create. Relevant audience growth, meaningful engagement and content performance improve through a clear rhythm of learning and optimization.

***About NiCE***

*NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.*

*Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.*

*NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Apex Leaders, LLC**

Apex Leaders custom-recruits industry experts for our private equity firm clients. Through a bespoke process, we research, vet, and connect our clients with the most relevant, skilled advisors so that they can quickly and confidently navigate investment opportunities.

We're seeking an enthusiastic Business Development Representative to join our team! This entry-level position is ideal for someone with 1-2 years of B2B sales experience or experience selling into private equity who is eager to build a career in financial services sales.

This is a hybrid position that will be based in the **New York City Metro Area** splitting time between working in the office and working remotely. The Business Development Representative will report directly to the VP of Sales and be a member of our sales team.

Apex Leaders is an equal-opportunity employer and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re a passionate team player who wants to have an impact on a diverse and dynamic team, we’d love to hear from you!

**Our Culture**

At Apex Leaders, you are surrounded by collaborative, tenacious teammates who push each other to overcome obstacles, test the status quo, and achieve success every single day. We hire people who work hard and challenge themselves while also having fun along the way, and are proud to be a **Top Work Place for 2024, 2025, & 2026.**

Our team is dedicated to creating a working environment where employees can grow and thrive. We pride ourselves on creating an atmosphere that embodies our core values of Team First Always, Give a Damn, and Find a Way.

**The Perks**

Our benefits are focused on enabling you to thrive both personally and professionally – it's about work/life balance, flexibility, and providing opportunities for growth and development. Some of our benefits include:

* The anticipated compensation for this role includes a base salary range of $60,000 - $70,000 per year and an uncapped commission plan. The total on-target earnings (OTE) are estimated to be between $80,000 and $105,000 annually. The final offer will be determined by a number of factors, including the candidate's relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.
* 100% employer-paid premiums on medical and dental insurance for the employee
* Fitness and wellness reimbursement
* 401K with matching
* Annual profit sharing program
* Extensive Paid Time Off (PTO):24 days of PTO + 11 paid holidays
* 6-week paid sabbatical every 5 years of service
* Paid parental leave
* Monthly culture events
* Volunteer initiatives

**About the role**

The Business Development Representative (BDR) plays an integral role between the marketing and the sales teams. This is a great opportunity for an individual looking to further their career at the intersection of sales and marketing for large ticket services ($250k plus annually). The purpose of this role is to convert prospects from various marketing and sales activities into opportunities for the sales team. The BDR works closely with the VP of Marketing, VP of Sales, and Account Executives to identify marketing promotions, define offers, identify prospect segments, compile lists that meet the relevant criteria, and lead sourcing and prospect outreach. The BDR qualifies potential prospects, gathers a sense of their operating orientation and listens to what they are seeking to do better as a firm to make future sales conversations more productive. The ideal candidate enjoys executing outbound email and phone sales strategies and implementing feedback loops on the success of various tactics. Additionally, this individual will seek to become proficient in developing a deep knowledge of prospects’ workflows and pain points, and the competitive positioning of Apex Leaders in the marketplace.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Working collaboratively with sales and marketing stakeholders to implement marketing and prospecting strategies
* Ability to execute several go-to-market strategies at the same time to bring in leads through cold calls and emails
* Qualify leads and lead introductory calls with prospective customers.
* Scheduling initial sales calls from a high volume outbound prospecting (up to 30+ calls/emails per day) to present Apex and qualify the prospect, and scheduling initial sales calls for BDDs
* Demonstrating mastery of common customer pain points, the company’s service lines, the competitive landscape and company’s differentiation in the marketplace
* Coachability and consistent mindset of continuous improvement for both skill sets and processes
* Consistently achieving established sales targets and quotas
* Maintaining precise performance data and delivering weekly analytics reports

**Location and Travel**

* **Location:** This role operates on a hybrid schedule, requiring 3 days per week on-site.
* **National Travel:** Willingness and ability to travel anywhere in the U.S. for industry conferences.
* **Local Travel:** Availability to represent the company at various local and regional city events.
* **Frequency:** Travel is required at a minimum of one trip per quarter, with potential for more based on business needs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred

**Experience**

* Skills in using CRM technology to track and manage new prospects relationships

We emphasize the look, feel, and scent in every product, transforming skincare into an elevated, sensual experience. jobs.title: Enterprise Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**REAL** is building an AI Execution Platform for real estate organizations. Today, the data required to run real estate is scattered across PDFs, spreadsheets, emails, drawings, public records, and disconnected systems, leading to preventable leakage, missed obligations and lost opportunities to improve performance.

Used by leading enterprises, REAL converts this fragmented data into connected intelligence and automated action. With advanced AI, universal ingestion, and modular execution agents, REAL increases operational accuracy, uncovers financial discrepancies, and surfaces opportunities to optimize performance and enhance business outcomes.

**REAL** **Values**

* **Ownership**: We take responsibility and move decisively.
* **Clarity**: We simplify complexity to deliver meaningful impact.
* **Accuracy**: Precision matters, in our product and in how we operate.
* **Velocity**: We work with urgency and intent.
* **Partnership**: We collaborate closely with our customers and with each other.

**The Role**

As a BDR at REAL, you’ll play a key role in building our pipeline and creating new business opportunities.

**This is a phone-first outbound sales role, with cold calling at the center of your day-to-day work.** You’ll combine phone outreach with email, LinkedIn, and other channels to engage prospects, understand their needs, and generate qualified meetings that contribute directly to our growth.

**What You’ll Do**

* Run high-volume outbound prospecting, with a strong focus on cold calling and live phone conversations.
* Identify and prioritize target accounts based on our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).
* Research prospects and personalize your approach based on their business, needs, and challenges.
* Use email, LinkedIn, and other channels alongside phone outreach to build engagement and generate qualified meetings.
* Conduct qualification calls with potential buyers and identify strong opportunities for the sales team.
* Handle objections confidently and turn cold conversations into meaningful sales opportunities.
* Maintain clean, accurate CRM records and track all outreach activity.
* Collaborate closely with Sales and Marketing to refine messaging, targeting, and outbound strategy.
* Take full ownership of pipeline quality and contribute directly to revenue growth.
* Stay up-to-date on product updates, market trends, and modern sales tools.

**Day-to-Day**

* Spend a significant part of your day on the phone, proactively reaching out to new prospects.
* Prospect new accounts using tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, and other sales tools.
* Make a high volume of outbound calls, supported by personalized emails and LinkedIn outreach.
* Speak directly with prospects, qualify opportunities, and book meetings with relevant decision-makers.
* Work closely with Account Executives to ensure smooth and effective meeting handoffs.
* Review your weekly performance, including call activity, conversations, and qualified meetings, and suggest new experiments or improvements.

  
**Requirements**  

### **What We’re Looking For:**

* **1–2 years of experience in a B2B outbound sales role,** such as an SDR or BDR.
* Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment, demonstrating adaptability, ownership, and the ability to thrive amid rapid change.
* Demonstrated success generating qualified meetings and initiating outbound conversations.
* Comfortable with structured outreach cadences and objection handling.
* Self-motivated, persistent, and results-driven.
* Familiarity with modern sales tech stacks (HubSpot, Salesforce, Apollo, Salesloft, or Outreach.io).
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Entrepreneurship, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is required.

**Nice to have**

* Experience testing and optimizing outreach sequences.
* Understanding of account-based sales or marketing (ABM).
* Experience collaborating with marketing or product teams.
* Desire to grow into an Account Executive, Account Manager, or Team Lead role.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager - Digital Paid Media - AI and Automation First
jobs.description:
New York, NY or Remote (US)

Eulerity is an AI-native marketing automation platform, built with AI from the start rather than added later. We automate digital advertising for enterprise brands like Mastercard, The UPS Store, Uber Eats, and European Wax Center across thousands of franchise and multi-location businesses.

We're hiring a client-facing Account Manager on our Customer Success team. You'll own a portfolio of brand relationships and be the strategic lead on their paid media performance. This role is for someone who has actually worked inside Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, and who knows how to turn what they see there into a recommendation a client will act on.

**Where You'll Work**
---------------------

This role is open to both remote and hybrid candidates. If you're based in the NYC area, we prefer a hybrid schedule with 2 days a week in our office. If you're outside NYC, you're welcome to work remote (within the US). Remote team members come to NYC for training, team days and key client meetings.

**Who We Are Looking For**
--------------------------

You are as comfortable in a C-suite conversation as you are inside a campaign dashboard. You do not wait for clients to surface problems; you spot the pattern before it becomes one. And when you make a recommendation, you can show your work.

If you have ever turned a flat renewal into an expansion just by asking the right questions, you will fit in here.

**What You Will Own**
---------------------

* **Your book of business.** You'll manage a portfolio of multi-location and franchise brands. You're the person they call when something matters.
* **Onboarding**. You'll run a high-touch onboarding process that sets up a long-term partnership from day one.
* **Performance strategy.** You'll build cross-channel plans across Google Search, Meta, YouTube, Display, and emerging channels, tied to each client's business goals and not just their media budget.
* **Business reviews.** You'll lead reviews that tell the real story in the data and bring a clear point of view on what to do next.
* **Optimization.** You'll work with our Technical Account Managers to monitor delivery, diagnose performance, and adjust campaigns.
* **Growth.** You'll find and close expansion opportunities through thoughtful upsells that make sense for the client, not ones pushed for quota.
* **Client advocacy.** You'll represent your clients inside Eulerity, working with Product and Engineering so that what we promise gets delivered.

**What We Want From You**
-------------------------

* ### **Must-haves**

  + 3–5 years in account management or client strategy at an ad agency, ad tech company, or media company.
  + Hands-on experience in Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager. You've personally built, managed, or directed campaigns, not just reviewed reports someone else built.
  + Experience managing client budgets across multiple accounts at the same time.
  + A track record of growing accounts, not just retaining them.
  + The ability to take performance data, find what's driving results, and present a clear recommendation to senior stakeholders.

  ### **Nice-to-haves**

  + Experience with franchise or multi-location brands, and an understanding of how corporate and franchisee decision-making differ.
  + Familiarity with YouTube, Display, or programmatic buying.
  + Experience in a SaaS or platform environment.
  + Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.

**Benefits**
------------

* Comprehensive benefits
  + Medical
  + Dental
  + Vision
* Unlimited PTO
* Commuter benefits
* 401(k) with company match
* Summer Fridays

**Compensation**
----------------

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our company's size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes benefits, perks, and other opportunities at Eulerity. The expected total compensation range for this role is $90,000 – $110,000, commensurate with experience.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
Join the CyberGuy Team

**Social Media Producer**
=========================

New York City area
  
Full-time
  
Primarily remote, with in-person shoots and meetings
  
$72,000–$82,000 annually, depending on experience

Create content that helps millions of people navigate technology with confidence.

CyberGuy is looking for a creative, resourceful Social Video & Editorial Producer to work directly with Kurt “CyberGuy” Knutsson and our digital, editorial, and production teams. You’ll turn useful tech advice, news, and original ideas into compelling videos and social posts that capture attention, build trust, and grow our audience.

Your strongest skill is storytelling. You know how to find an angle, shoot and edit a polished video, write a strong caption, and carry an idea through publication. You’re also comfortable managing social channels, supporting paid campaigns, and using results to make the next piece better.

**Your first 90 days:** This is a regular full-time position. We set clear goals and review progress together, with check-ins at 30, 60, and 90 days.

**About CyberGuy**
------------------

CyberGuy delivers award-winning technology reporting, reviews, and practical advice across television, digital, social media, newsletters, podcasts, and live classes. Our mission is to help people make smarter tech decisions and protect their privacy, security, and safety.

We’re a small, collaborative team where your ideas and execution have a visible impact. We value initiative, accuracy, clear communication, and thoughtful work.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Create original video.** Develop, shoot, and edit demonstrations, interviews, explainers, and behind-the-scenes stories with Kurt in NYC. Adapt television and podcast material into engaging social content.
* **Own daily social publishing.** Manage content across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest, Threads, and LinkedIn, tailoring each post to its platform and audience.
* **Write and package compelling posts.** Create headlines, captions, descriptions, thumbnails, and graphics. Check facts, spelling, links, subtitles, tags, formatting, and disclosures before publication, and review posts after they go live.
* **Keep production moving.** Maintain the content calendar, coordinate assets and approvals, and prepare for shoots with the information and materials needed to execute well.
* **Turn results into better content.** Track retention, watch time, engagement, clicks, and conversions where measurable. Test ideas and recommend specific improvements.
* **Support paid campaigns.** Help launch, monitor, and optimize Facebook, Instagram, and other relevant advertising campaigns.
* **Stay connected to our audience.** Follow CyberGuy’s reporting and audience conversations, monitor comments, and bring forward timely ideas that fit our voice and mission.

You’ll work closely with the SVP Digital on strategy, creative direction, campaigns, and audience growth.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* At least two years of relevant experience in social media, filmmaking, journalism, or digital content production.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating storytelling, shooting, editing, and social copywriting, especially for vertical video.
* Proficiency with tools such as Adobe Premiere, CapCut, Canva, or comparable software.
* Experience managing social channels, content calendars, publishing tools, and competing deadlines.
* Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and an understanding of social analytics.
* An interest in consumer technology and the ability to make complicated topics clear and engaging.
* Excellent attention to detail, reliable follow-through, and the judgment to ask questions early and solve problems independently.

Experience with WordPress, affiliate marketing, TikTok Shop, or additional advertising platforms is a plus.

**Benefits**
------------

For eligible full-time team members:

* **Comprehensive medical coverage.** Anthem Blue Cross PPO coverage, with KTCG paying 80% of the employee premium and 50% of eligible dependent premiums.
* **Company-paid dental and vision.** KTCG pays 100% of the employee premium for Humana dental and vision coverage. Dependent coverage is also available at the employee’s expense.
* **Generous paid time away.** Earn up to 80 hours of paid vacation annually, plus nine paid Company holidays, an eight-hour floating holiday and paid sick leave based on your primary work location.
* **Annual incentive bonus opportunity.** This position is eligible for a performance-based annual bonus based on individual and Company performance.
* **Remote-first flexibility.** Work primarily from your approved home location with reasonable flexibility in organizing your day, balanced with agreed working hours, scheduled meetings, deadlines, breaking-news demands, and production needs.
* **Production access and meaningful impact.** Work directly with Kurt and a small, collaborative team creating content that reaches and helps millions of people.

**Apply for This Job**
----------------------

Submit your resume and cover letter, along with:

* **Five to ten links to social posts you personally created.** Explain your contribution to each, including concept, shooting, editing, graphics, copy, publishing, or analysis.
* Examples of video you shot or edited, including short-form social content.
* Examples of paid campaigns you worked on, identifying the platforms and your role in managing or optimizing them.
* One example of how you used performance data to improve content or a campaign, including what you changed and what you learned.
* **One example of an AI efficiency you have implemented.** Briefly explain the task, the tool or approach you tested, and how it improved your workflow or results.

Email your application to jobs@cyberguy.com.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**The Company**  
  
Everflow is a SaaS Partner Marketing platform for managing and scaling revenue from affiliates, partnerships, and marketing channels.

Founded in 2016 by industry veterans, we are based in Oakland, Montreal and Amsterdam with a distributed team across the NAM and EMEA regions.

We’re a bootstrapped company (over $30M ARR) that has grown through supporting happy customers that refer business to us and create word-of-mouth excitement. We’re the go-to platform for brands, agencies, and networks, with 1,000+ customers including Mutual of Omaha, ClassPass, and Tapjoy.

**We are accepting applications from candidates that reside in the following areas:**

* New York: NYC
* Florida: St. Pete Area

To meet growing electricity demand, we are deploying emerging technologies and strategically investing in our grid to keep service reliable and affordable for our customers.

The Grid Strategy & Solutions (GSS) team leads Georgia Power's pursuit and execution of federal and state funding, along with emerging grid technology initiatives. The programs that GSS manages for Power Delivery represent a growing, multi-billion-dollar portfolio that must be executed with discipline, accuracy, and strong cross-functional coordination.

The Project Coordinator will play a pivotal role supporting Georgia Power's Strategic Projects within Grid Strategy & Solutions. Reporting to the Project Manager for federal funding, this position supports the project managers and technical leads on the team while owning responsibility for the coordination of logistics, compliance, and reporting deliverables, and facilitating communication across internal teams and external agencies. The Coordinator helps keep the portfolio moving from funding award through execution by maintaining trackers and schedules, compiling reports and compliance deliverables, organizing project documentation, and preparing clear materials for leadership and external partners. In addition, this position supports the identification and evaluation of strategic funding opportunities and the integration of emerging grid technologies that help modernize grid infrastructure and improve system reliability.

Since inception in 2015, BPM has produced nearly 400 concerts on stadium fields with artists like Chris Stapleton, Snoop Dogg, Zac Brown Band, Marshmello, Thomas Rhett, Weezer, Run DMC, The Avett Brothers, T-Pain, Diplo, Old Dominion, Ludacris, Sam Hunt, AJR, Jordan Davis, Riley Green, Nelly and many, many more. BPM has also handled the on-field production for MLB’s All-Star Week (2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), as well as trophy presentations for the ALCS, NLCS and World Series since 2017.  
  
**Job Summary:**  
We are seeking a talented and driven individual to join Ballpark Music. This person will be directly assisting the President of BPM in all areas including, but not limited to, artist management communications, presenting concert ideas to teams, contract negotiations, maintaining schedules and organized event planning, office management, company HR needs, paperwork coordination, and any activities that keep the company, and the President, running smoothly and efficiently. * Act as the primary point of contact for all marketing assets for BPM clients
* Help implement strategic marketing plans for upcoming concerts to maximize audience engagement and ticket sales
* Stay up to date with industry trends and best practices in both the sports and entertainment sectors to identify new marketing opportunities
* Act as the point of contact for non-technical elements for shows including, but not limited to, coordinating catering, hospitality, crew calls, hotel arrangements, flights, ground, stagehands, techs, show logistics and the show itself
* No job too big, no job too small – this position, like everyone at BPM, will be involved in every facet of planning and executing each show. You will be involved in high level conceptualization of creating world-class events as well as making sure crews have water on site and everything in-between.

  
**Job Skills & Qualifications:**  

* Amazing personal skills and relationship building
* Excellent organizational, oral, and written communication skills
* Bachelor’s degree. Preferably in marketing, business, music production, or sports-related disciplines

jobs.description:
**Catering Sales Representative – Join GYRO GYRO DUNWOODY!**
------------------------------------------------------------

At GYRO GYRO DUNWOODY, located in the heart of Dunwoody, GA, we’re passionate about serving up delicious Mediterranean flavors and creating memorable dining experiences. Now, we’re looking for a part-time **Catering Sales Representative** to help us grow our catering business by building strong relationships with local organizations and turning first-time customers into loyal regulars. If you’re a go-getter with a knack for sales and a love for food, we’d love to hear from you!

### **Responsibilities**

As our Catering Sales Representative, you’ll focus on connecting with local offices, schools, churches, teams, and other organizations to grow our catering business. Here’s what your day-to-day will look like:

* Build and manage a list of potential customers by making calls, sending emails, visiting locations, and hosting tastings.
* Quote orders from our price list, close deals, and ensure all order details—like headcount, allergies, timing, and setup—are accurate before handing them off to the kitchen.
* Personally follow up with every new client after their first order and be on-site for big first-time setups.
* Maintain relationships with existing accounts by checking in monthly and encouraging repeat orders.
* Regularly review your sales pipeline and progress with the owner.

This role is all about finding new customers, winning their trust, and keeping them coming back, so you’ll spend your time building relationships—not packing pans or handling deliveries.

### **Qualifications**

We’re looking for someone with:

* **1+ year of experience** in B2B sales, catering or event sales, or account management with named clients.
* A proven track record of finding new customers and generating your own leads.
* A valid driver’s license and an insured vehicle.
* Availability to work **15–20 hours per week** on weekdays.

Bonus points if you have:

* Existing contacts at offices, schools, or organizations in Dunwoody, Perimeter, Sandy Springs, or Doraville.
* Experience in the restaurant or catering industry.
* Familiarity with CRM tools or ezCater.

### **Pay**

We offer a competitive pay structure:

* **$20/hour** base pay.
* **15% commission** on every new account’s first order.
* **5% commission** on reorders for the first 12 months, with additional performance-based tiers for accounts beyond 12 months.
* Quarterly bonuses for hitting growth and retention goals.

This is a part-time role with no cap on commission, so your success depends on the relationships you build and the accounts you grow.

### **How to Apply**

Ready to join our team? Apply through this posting and, in **two or three sentences**, tell us about one customer you won and how you did it. We’re excited to hear your story!

At Gyro Gyro, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, including veterans and military spouses. Let’s grow something delicious together!
