jobs.title: Counter Sales Representative
jobs.description:
***We are looking for a Counter Sales Associate to join our growing team!***

At PDI, our goal is to always be committed to providing quality products with prompt, efficient, courteous service in all segments of our business. We pride ourselves in keeping flexibility of procedures and policy at the forefront so that customer needs are always satisfied.

Since 1973, we have maintained our position as a leader in the wholesale distribution industry and offer first-class service to customers in the residential and commercial plumbing industries, as well as home builders, interior designers, re-modelers, and homeowners. We operate 19 branch locations and 13 showrooms throughout Georgia, Tennessee, and South Carolina.

**Function**: As a Counter Sales Associate, your primary responsibility is to assist customers with their product inquiries, process orders, and provide exceptional service at the sales counter. You will serve as the main point of contact for walk-in customers, contractors, and plumbers, ensuring their needs are met and contributing to the overall sales and profitability of the branch.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Greet customers as they arrive at the counter, assess their needs, and provide product recommendations and solutions based on their requirements. Answer inquiries about product availability, specifications, pricing, and application, providing accurate and detailed information to assist customers in making purchasing decisions.
* Process sales orders, quotes, and invoices accurately and efficiently using the company's order entry system. Verify product availability, pricing, and discounts, and confirm order details with customers to ensure accuracy and satisfaction.
* Develop a comprehensive understanding of the company's product offerings, including plumbing fixtures, fittings, pipes, valves, and accessories. Stay informed about new products, promotions, and industry trends to effectively educate customers and promote sales opportunities.
* Identify opportunities to cross-sell or upsell related products and accessories to customers based on their needs and preferences. Recommend complementary items, upgrades, or alternative solutions to maximize sales and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Provide friendly, professional, and responsive service to all customers, addressing their inquiries, concerns, and requests in a timely and courteous manner. Resolve customer complaints or issues promptly and escalate complex issues to the appropriate supervisor or manager for resolution.
* Assist with order fulfillment processes, including picking, packing, and staging orders for customer pickup or delivery. Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams to ensure timely and accurate order fulfillment and minimize order processing errors or delays.
* Process cash, credit card, and check transactions accurately and securely, following established cash handling procedures and protocols. Balance cash register at the end of each shift and reconcile any discrepancies with supervisor or manager oversight.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment at the counter area, adhering to company policies, safety regulations, and industry standards. Follow proper procedures for handling hazardous materials, maintaining equipment, and ensuring workplace safety for employees and customers.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues in sales, customer service, warehouse, and management to meet customer needs, resolve issues, and achieve sales targets. Communicate product availability, customer feedback, and sales opportunities to relevant team members to support overall branch success.

**Principle Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Previous experience in sales, customer service, or counter sales, preferably in the plumbing wholesale industry.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and establish positive relationships with customers.
* Excellent product knowledge and understanding of plumbing materials, fixtures, and equipment.
* Proficiency in computer skills, including POS systems, order entry software, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
* Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and quality in all aspects of work.
* Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional service and exceeding customer expectations.

You'll be training and working directly with the CEO!

You'll work remotely when conducting research, making calls, and sending emails, and spend time in the field visiting businesses and meeting prospective clients throughout Metro Atlanta.

jobs.description:
**Department**

BSD CCC - Network Oncology Research Support

**About the Department**

The University of Chicago Comprehensive Cancer Center (UCCCC) is an integral component of the Biological Sciences Division (BSD). The BSD is the largest of four Divisions of the University and includes the Pritzker School of Medicine. UCCCC administers four established scientific programs, and the NCI-sponsored Cancer Center Support Grant funds ten Shared Resources. The Comprehensive Cancer Center comprises over 190 faculty members from twenty departments, with members currently being awarded over $47 million in total direct costs in peer-reviewed cancer research grants, and $28 million in non-peer-reviewed grants and contracts. The activities of the Center are broad and varied, including research, training and education, communications, fundraising, marketing, clinical trials management, and community outreach.  
  
UCCCC has one of the largest cancer clinical trials programs in the country and in the Chicago area, with nearly 500 adult and pediatric therapeutic trials actively accruing patients. Many of these studies are investigator-initiated, including Phase I or I/II trials, demonstrating UCCCC's commitment to translating basic research findings to the clinic through proof-of-principle and early-phase studies. UCCCC opens over 250 new trials each year and accrues approximately 900 participants to therapeutic trials each year.

**Job Summary**

The Clinical Research Coordinator 2 (CRC2) is a specialized researcher partnering with the clinical Principal Investigator (PI) and under the direction of a departmental or lab research manager. While the Principal Investigator is primarily responsible for the overall design, conduct, and management of the clinical trial, the CRC2 supports, facilitates and coordinates independently the daily clinical trial activities and plays a critical role in the conduct of the study. * Performs other related work as needed.

jobs.title: Retail Sales Representative, Chicago
jobs.description:
At Ferrara, Ferrero, Fox’s Burton’s, and The Fine Biscuits Company, we’re loved by people of all generations for the joy we bring—and that joy is crafted by our people. Join us and explore a whole world to discover, where your passion will find its place.

Today, Ferrara is the #1 sugar confectioner in the U.S, with global sales in more than 40 countries. Ferrara boasts a passionate team of over 9,000 employees around the world who deliver and create hundreds of iconic and beloved products.

In the U.S., more than 67 million households annually enjoy our popular brands like NERDS®, Brach’s®, Jelly Belly®, SweeTARTS®, Laffy Taffy®, and Trolli®. In Brazil, Dori has become a household name with snacking products that include brands such as Dori, Gomets, Pettiz, and Yogurte 100. And, in France, Carambar & Co have earned generations of loyal customers through the timeless appeal of iconic candy and chocolate brands such as Carambar, Lutti, Krema, Poulain, Vichy and Terry’s. A privately held company, Ferrara Group is headquartered in Chicago. Ferrara boasts a network of over 30 locations in North America, South America, Europe and Asia Pacific that includes manufacturing, distribution, sales, and R&D facilities.

Learn more at www.ferrara.com or www.linkedin.com/company/ferrara-/

**Retail Sales Representative, Chicago**
========================================

**Work Location: Chicago**
--------------------------

**Want to make an impact?**
---------------------------

The Retail Sales Representative ensures perfect retail execution of store level sales and priority plans within an assigned territory. This is an entry point into our Ferrara Sales organization. This territory consists of high-volume grocers and mass merchandise customers. Integrity is a crucial component of this role and requires the ability to work independently without direct supervision all while working effectively and efficiently.

  

This position is responsible for achieving sales KPI objectives including overall sales growth of assigned territory, 100% distribution on Ferrara and Ferrero products, build and maintain in-store displays, and maintain shelf integrity. This role leads the overall relationship at the store level. A successful sales representative will be driven, communicative, influential, entrepreneurial, and organized.

  

\*\*NOTE: THIS ROLE IS REMOTE\*\*

**Ways you will make a difference**
-----------------------------------

**Key Responsibilities**

**Distribution:**

* Audit key Ferrara and Ferrero SKUs at front registers and center store to ensure on-shelf availability and close distribution gaps.

**Sales & Merchandising:**

* Leveraging fact base selling tools and technology to sell priorities to the Key Decision Makers (KDM’s). These include company priorities and incremental displays to increase territory sales.
* Leverage promotional activity to increase Point-of-Sale (POS) by forward-selling displays and national marketing events.
* Utilize selling techniques to influence KDMS to order additional products to secure secondary displays throughout the store.
* Place Point of Sales (POS) and Instant Redeemable Coupons (IRCs) as needed.
* Maintain on shelf availability by correcting any out of stocks with top stock or back-stock inventory.
* Transport product to and from the back room to shelf locations and all displays to maintain shelf and display capacity.

**Data Analysis:**

* Review specific territory business (KPIs, trends, gaps/opportunities), provide solutions where gap exists and execute these solutions accordingly. Own and lead this territory with store and management team.
* Enforce compliance throughout the year by providing business updates to the KDMs in each store.
* Use data to identify up-selling opportunities to gain incremental displays/features.
* Review Tableau reports to monitor results and take action to address any opportunities to win in the territory.

**Communication:**

* Build and maintain business relationships with Walmart store’s key decision makers.
* Engage in weekly calls with peers while proactively sharing best practices, solutions, and insights across the team.
* Participate in conference calls, trainings, and attend all sales meetings.

**Administration:**

* Effectively manage stores within assigned territory to meet required frequencies and coverage KPIs.
* When necessary, will complete accurate timely reports, recaps, and expense reports.
* Report any item discrepancies, store issues, key competitor, and category information to the District Sales Manager.

* Understands and demonstrates the Company’s core values: empowerment, collaboration, agility, integrity, and empathy.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Skills that will make you successful**
----------------------------------------

* High level of demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities with tight deadlines.
* Organized, detail-oriented, and excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating with personnel from all levels of management.
* Self-directed, independent, motivated, and excellent time management and prioritization skills.
* Ability to utilize analytical skills to identify and communicate store and territory data.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to influence others.
* Ability to embrace change and new ways of working.
* Ability to recognize obstacles and involve others to take immediate action to move things forward.
* Ability to analyze financial, inventory, retail conditions and/or other data to adapt appropriate selling approach.
* Proficient computer skills utilizing Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Power Point, Word and Access and Outlook) Must be able to use tablet and other wireless technology.

**Experiences that will support your success**
----------------------------------------------

* BS/BA required.
* A minimum of 1-2 years of successful Retail and/or Consumer Goods experience preferred.
* Industry/Retail Knowledg

jobs.description:
**Lead Digital Production Coordinator (Hybrid)**

**Chicago, IL**

The American Medical Association (AMA) is the nation's largest professional Association of physicians and a non-profit organization. We are a unifying voice and powerful ally for America's physicians, the patients they care for, and the promise of a healthier nation. To be part of the AMA is to be part of our Mission to promote the art and science of medicine and the betterment of public health.

At AMA, our mission to improve the health of the nation starts with our people. We foster an inclusive, people-first culture where every employee is empowered to perform at their best. Together, we advance meaningful change in health care and the communities we serve.

We encourage and support professional development for our employees, and we are dedicated to social responsibility. We invite you to learn more about us and we look forward to getting to know you.

We have an opportunity at our corporate offices in Chicago for a **Lead Digital Production Coordinator (Hybrid)** on our Education Center team. This is a hybrid position reporting into our Chicago, IL office, requiring 3 days a week in the office.

  

As a Lead Digital Production Coordinator, you will coordinate and execute production operations to support the digital publication and transformation of medical education. Develop and refine XML-based publishing processes and content formats to support new media and content offerings. Monitor and complete publishing workflows, troubleshoot complex production issues, and maintain consistency across digital publishing channels. Collaborate with learning design, CME, production vendors, platform providers, marketing, and publication teams, providing technical guidance and coordinating vendor publishing and quality assurance activities.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Publishing Operations**

* Create, transform, and deliver data (metadata and full text conversion/tagging to XML); package and publish structured and related files for delivery to AMA platforms, aggregators, and applications
* Coordinate vendor publishing activities, delivering files based on production schedules, providing technical guidance, and monitoring accuracy, quality, and deadlines
* Monitor content keyword tagging in a finished good repository to identify and resolve tagging issues impacting transfers, partnering with IT to identify errors, e.g. DTD
* Publish and revise content renewals XML and archive content as needed; develop and refine content redirect requests for archived content; process ad hoc requests related to content status (edits, expiring, etc.)
* Coordinate the publishing of multimedia across multiple online platforms e.g. Spotify, Cadmore, Descript, Libsyn, and support the development of new multimedia content formats
* Assess and refine publication processes, developing approaches and documentation to support new content formats and publishing requirements

**Quality Assurance**

* Perform quality assurance testing of all editorial content following established guidelines to check for completeness and quality throughout of text, tables, graphics, PDF linking, and interactivity etc.; manually resolve XML issues when able, surfacing vendor-required corrections
* Prepare urgent and other post-publication correction requests as approved by management, or if adhering to content revision policy, accurately supply content for database population; and provide other information/data as required
* Ensure XML data integrity, accuracy of coding, completeness, and validity against NLM JATS (National Library of Medicine Journal Article Tagging Suite), DTD, and HighWire DTD
* Review and maintain bug tracking logs and reports to optimize workstream performance
* Effectively communicate and coordinate technical and/or workflow issues with Editorial and other Production staff to troubleshoot, modify, and resupply files as necessary; monitor inter-system interface/data transfer issues; raise any error notices received and verify content packaging adheres to platform technical requirements
* Apply CME accreditation of published content requirements and documentation

**Planning & Collaboration**

* Coordinate the testing of new XML functionality, platform features, and styles. Communicate technical knowledge, workflow processes, and troubleshooting guidance to stakeholders and users across departments
* Draft publishing guidelines and processes for vendors, provide technical guidance, and oversee the quality and consistency of vendor XML tagging and publication work
* Apply XML knowledge to help develop and refine content formats and publishing approaches that enhance website user engagement and user experience
* Collaborate with marketing, project management, IT, and editorial on the development of new media and content offerings, addressing technical requirements, publishing approaches, and audience experience
* Work closely with AMA content creators to develop publishing documentation and communicate content requirements, processes, and guidelines

**May include other responsibilities as assigned**

  

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Education: Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent work experience and HS diploma/equivalent education required (P1-P4/M1-M2)
* Years of experience: 5+ years of experience in an online publishing environment, preferably academic or journal publishing
* Bachelor’s Degree in a related field preferred (journalism, computer sciences, publishing, electronic publishing); comparable work experience in electronic or web publishing acceptable

The American Medical Association is located at 330 N. Wabash Avenue, Chicago, IL 60611 and is convenient to all public transportation in Chicago.

About Syngenta

At Syngenta Seeds Field Crops, we're shaping the future of agriculture and empowering farmers to meet the ever-growing demand for food and fuel. We’re a global Ag Tech powerhouse, headquartered in the United States, with passionate, local experts collaborating with farmers to deliver solutions that create market opportunities. We unite precision breeding, advanced biotechnology trait choice, and digital platforms for unmatched in-field performance. Our seeds help mitigate risks such as disease, insect, weed, and extreme weather pressures, all while promoting sustainable farming practices that protect and enhance our planet. Join our mission of revolutionizing food security and transforming agriculture.

 **Job Description**

As the Brand & Digital Marketing Manager, you will lead the North America Seeds Brand & Digital Marketing organization, setting portfolio strategy and converting business priorities into integrated, measurable customer and channel experiences.

**WeDriveU** is the leader in shared mobility solutions that connect communities, campuses, and workplaces. WeDriveU operates private shuttle and public transit systems across the U.S serving millions of passenger journeys a year. The company's 5,500+ team members operate 4,000 vehicles across 55 U.S. locations, providing safe, reliable and sustainable options as part of a global family of brands serving more than 1 billion bus and rail passengers on four continents. Visit wedriveu.com to learn more about our company, clients and career opportunities.

**Position Summary**

WeDriveU is seeking a detail-oriented Maintenance Operations Coordinator to support the daily administrative and operational functions of our fleet maintenance department. This role maintains accurate maintenance records, manages work orders in Maximo, coordinates parts and inventory activities, and supports communication between Maintenance and Operations. The ideal candidate has a working understanding of automotive or fleet maintenance operations, strong organizational skills, and experience managing maintenance information and administrative processes. This is primarily an administrative position and does not involve routine hands-on vehicle repairs.

**Responsibilities**

MAINTENANCE SYSTEMS AND WORK ORDER MANAGEMENT

* Open, update, track, and close maintenance work orders in Maximo, keeping information accurate and complete.
* Enter and maintain repair information, labor details, parts usage, and related documentation.
* Monitor outstanding work orders and coordinate with maintenance personnel for timely updates and completion.
* Maintain accurate vehicle maintenance histories, service records, and supporting documentation.
* Help maintain vehicle asset information in Maximo so records reflect the current fleet at the assigned location.

MAINTENANCE ADMINISTRATION AND COORDINATION

* Support the daily administrative activities of the Maintenance Department.
* Coordinate with Operations to help schedule vehicles for preventive maintenance, inspections, and repairs.
* Facilitate communication between maintenance technicians, supervisors, vendors, and operational personnel.
* Organize and maintain maintenance records, inspection documents, invoices, and other departmental files.
* Assist maintenance leadership with administrative follow-up, documentation, and departmental priorities.

PARTS AND INVENTORY ADMINISTRATION

* Request and process quotations for maintenance parts, supplies, and outside services.
* Prepare parts and inventory requisitions for purchase order processing.
* Receive and record parts and inventory transactions in Maximo.
* Assist with tracking inventory records and reconciling discrepancies.
* Coordinate with maintenance personnel and vendors on parts orders, deliveries, and documentation.

PROCESS IMPROVEMENT, TECHNOLOGY AND AUTOMATION

* Identify opportunities to improve and automate maintenance and administrative processes to increase efficiency, effectiveness, and quality.
* Help eliminate unnecessary administrative steps, duplicate data entry, and repetitive manual tasks.
* Use company-approved AI and digital tools to streamline maintenance coordination, reporting, documentation, and follow-up activities.
* Assist with developing practical solutions that simplify workflows and improve the accuracy and timeliness of maintenance information.
* Work with maintenance leadership to identify operational challenges and recommend process improvements.
* Support the implementation of new tools, automated workflows, and improved administrative procedures.

REPORTING AND RECORD ACCURACY

* Generate maintenance reports and provide information requested by maintenance leadership.
* Monitor work order records and identify missing, incomplete, or inaccurate information.
* Support accurate tracking of maintenance activities, preventive maintenance schedules, and vehicle service histories.
* Help maintain records needed for internal reviews, audits, and applicable maintenance compliance requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes, documentation accuracy, and maintenance system use.

**Qualifications**

REQUIRED

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Previous experience in automotive service, fleet maintenance administration, maintenance coordination, or a related environment.
* Working knowledge of automotive or fleet maintenance terminology, repair processes, and maintenance operations.
* Experience with computerized recordkeeping, work order systems, or maintenance management software.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with maintenance technicians, operations personnel, and management.

PREFERRED

* Experience using IBM Maximo or a comparable computerized maintenance management system (CMMS).
* Experience in commercial fleet maintenance, transportation, automotive dealerships, or vehicle service operations.
* Familiarity with preventive maintenance programs, parts inventory, and maintenance reporting.
* Experience supporting maintenance recordkeeping, documentation reviews, or audit preparation.

ADDITIONAL EXPECTATIONS

Working with the Relocation Project Management (RPM) team, the Asset/Move Coordinator I supports FF&E planning, procurement, budget and schedule tracking, deliveries, installation, and move coordination across multiple LACCD campuses.

Under the direction of the College Project Director and RPM leadership, this position coordinates with campus representatives, project teams, designers, vendors, and movers throughout pre-move planning, installation, relocation, and closeout.

**THE PURPOSE:** The Social Media + Community Manager brings True Religion’s brand to life through compelling social content and meaningful community connections, both online and IRL. Reporting to the Director, Social Media, this role balances two equally important responsibilities: managing day-to-day social planning, content briefing, publishing, and performance reporting; and building an engaged community through conversation, relationship-building, and social listening. Working closely with the content creator and cross-functional partners, this person translates social strategy into a consistent, culturally relevant presence that grows awareness, engagement, advocacy, and traffic to TrueReligion.com and stores.

### **THE ROLE (what you are accountable for):**

**SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGEMENT**

* Own the day-to-day social content calendar, translating the Director’s strategy into monthly plans and weekly publishing schedules across Instagram, TikTok, and other priority channels. Balance campaigns, product storytelling, cultural moments, and community-led content.

* Develop clear content briefs for creative partners, outlining the objective, audience, key message, platform, format, hook, deliverables, and timing. Provide feedback and coordinate revisions to keep work on brief.
* Write and adapt captions, copy, calls to action, and platform-specific messaging in the brand voice. Check final assets, tags, links, product details, inventory, and approvals before publishing.

* Monitor post performance and recommend improvements to content mix, formats, hooks, posting cadence, and timing. Maintain an organized asset library and accurate calendar and publishing records.

**COMMUNITY MANAGEMENT**

* Own daily community management across priority social channels, responding to comments, direct messages, mentions, and tags with timely, thoughtful, on-brand replies.

### **REQUIRED MINIMUM EXPERIENCE**

* Excellent writing and content briefing skills, with the ability to adapt brand voice across captions, creative briefs, and community conversations
* Experience managing comments, direct messages, and escalations, including handling negative feedback and sensitive issues with good judgment
* Hands-on experience with social media management and listening tools, such as Sprout Social, Hootsuite, or Brandwatch
* Strong analytical skills, with experience producing weekly social and community reports and translating performance data into clear recommendations
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to coordinate calendars, assets, approvals, and competing deadlines while responding to timely community needs

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

* Basic photo and video editing skills, using tools such as CapCut, Canva, or Adobe Creative Suite

new_jobs.description:
**Location:** Hybrid - Santa Ana, CA  
**Type:** Full-Time  
**Salary:** $75,000 – $90,000 base, depending on experience

### **About eJam**

eJam is a privately held consumer products company that has built, scaled, and exited multiple brands. Our portfolio includes category leaders ranked at the top of Amazon, carried in major retailers nationwide, and sold across DTC, marketplaces, and every channel in between.

We’re not a startup hoping something works. We’re a team that has done it repeatedly: taken products from idea to category leader, landed them on retail shelves nationwide, and built real brands that consumers love. We operate like a holding company with the speed of a startup: small teams with real ownership and accountability.

This is the place where you’ll see the entire machine: sourcing, product development, packaging, manufacturing, compliance, marketing, marketplace strategy, retail, all under one roof. If you want to build and ship consumer products at scale, there is no better place than this.

### **The Role**

You will own the path from a customer order to recognized, reconciled revenue across every eJam channel, end to end. Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, QVC and retail each report revenue, refunds, fees and payouts differently, and you make them agree: one gross to net waterfall per brand, one daily revenue number the CEO, finance and media buyers all trust, and channel payouts that tie to the bank.

You will be the person who finds where the cash went missing, and the one who brings receivables management in house as we retire our outsourced A/R partner.

**Mission:** Finance and brand leadership know what we actually earned yesterday, by brand and channel, and every dollar between gross sales and the bank is explained, before they have to ask.

### **What You'll Own**

**Revenue data and reporting**

* Own the daily gross to net revenue report by brand and channel: gross sales, discounts, refunds, chargebacks, merchant and agency fees, sales tax and net revenue, and explain every movement
* Maintain the revenue layer of the BigQuery finance and goal pacing dashboards so the numbers the business runs on match what Accounting books
* Build and automate recurring revenue, subscription and channel performance reports, and replace manual spreadsheet pulls with repeatable queries
* Track subscription revenue health: rebill approval rates, declines, retries, churn and refund drivers, and flag what needs action

**Reconciliation and receivables**

* Reconcile Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop and payment processor payouts and settlements to the bank and the ledger each period, and chase every unexplained difference to its source
* Support the month end close with revenue, refund, chargeback and fee reconciliations, and the related journal entry support
* Manage retail and marketplace receivables (QVC, Target, Walmart, Kroger and the SAI portfolio as it moves in house): invoicing, remittance matching, deductions and short pays, and an aging the team acts on
* Own the sales tax data flow and marketplace facilitator treatment with our tax platform

**Process and systems**

* The order to cash process documented per channel, with control points and SOPs the team runs on, built with the data, subscription, customer support and media teams
* Recurring revenue reporting automated with Claude and documented so it survives a vacation

### **What Success Looks Like**

* **30 days:** the daily gross to net report publishes by brand without manual intervention and every channel's payout reconciliation is documented
* **90 days:** BigQuery revenue ties to QuickBooks Online for the prior month with a written bridge for every known difference, and retail and marketplace receivables aging is owned end to end
* **6 months:** order to cash SOPs exist for every channel, unreconciled revenue differences sit at zero at close, two recurring reports run materially faster, and the business trusts one revenue number

  
**Requirements**

**Required (all four, no exceptions)**

* **Order to cash:** tied Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, Stripe or similar settlements and payouts back to the general ledger and found a gap
* **Gross to net:** built a bridge from gross sales through discounts, refunds, chargebacks, fees and tax to net revenue, and explained what moved
* **Subscription:** worked rebill approval, decline, retry and churn data for a recurring revenue business
* **Receivables:** managed retail or marketplace A/R, including remittance matching, deductions and short pays, with an aging someone acted on

**Also required**

* 3 to 7 years in revenue operations, revenue accounting or finance operations, ideally at a DTC, subscription or ecommerce brand
* Advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, Power Query) and working SQL, BigQuery or another warehouse preferred, with dashboards in Looker Studio, Tableau or Power BI
* You use AI, primarily Claude, as a working tool every day, and you check its output before it goes anywhere
* Bachelor's in finance, accounting, economics, analytics or related

**Nice to have**

* QuickBooks Online or Ramp
* A subscription or order management stack
* Sales tax and marketplace facilitator mechanics (TaxJar, Numeral or Avalara)
* Amazon settlement reporting

  
**Benefits**  

### **Compensation**

$75,000 to $90,000 base, depending on experience.

### **Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision
* 401(k) Plan
* Company-paid life insurance, AD&D, and long-term disability
* PTO and 14 Observed Holidays
* Amazing, dog-friendly office in Santa Ana, CA
* Learning & development opportunities

new_jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Nitrogen Express is a family-owned industrial and specialty gas distribution business. We supply businesses that need gases and related products to keep their operations running. We earn revenue by selling and delivering products and by keeping customers invoiced, collected, and serviced reliably.

**About the Position**

We need one accountable, in-office owner for the company’s day-to-day financial administration and office operating rhythm. The work is important to cash flow, vendor relationships, customer experience, and good decision-making. We want to replace fragmented processes with reliable systems—not just fill a desk.

This is a high-visibility seat in a stable, family-owned business where a capable person can make a real difference. The person will not be stuck doing one narrow transaction all day. They will own meaningful financial workflows, work directly with the owner, improve how the business operates, and build systems that matter. It is an excellent opportunity for someone who is tired of being buried in a large company or limited to a narrow AP/AR silo and wants broader responsibility.

**Responsibilities**

This person should own the day-to-day financial workflows for a small operating business, with appropriate owner review and approval on major decisions and payments.

* Maintain clean, timely QuickBooks Online records and supporting documentation.
* Drive invoicing promptly and accurately; identify missing information before it creates a billing delay.
* Own the accounts-receivable rhythm: aging review, professional customer follow-up, notes, escalation, and collections follow-through.
* Organize accounts payable: receive and code bills, maintain vendor files, prepare a clear weekly payables list, and make sure nothing important is missed. Owner approval remains required for payments.
* Support bank and credit-card reconciliations, month-end readiness, and clear financial reporting for the owner and outside accounting support.
* Create, document, and maintain practical SOPs for invoicing, collections, payables, customer account setup, and file management.
* Use Excel, QuickBooks, and secure AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to reduce manual work, catch errors, create follow-up drafts, improve reporting, and make processes more reliable.
* Serve as a dependable, professional in-office point of contact for customers, vendors, and the team.

**First 30 / 60 / 90 days**

* Learn the business, customer/payment cycles, QuickBooks structure, vendors, and current workflow.
* Take control of the AR aging and open-payables visibility.
* Identify immediate invoicing, collections, and file-organization gaps.
* Establish a weekly owner-facing cash, receivables, and payables rhythm.

* Implement a consistent invoice-to-collection process and documented collection cadence.
* Clean up vendor, customer, and supporting-document workflows.
* Create clear SOPs for the highest-risk recurring tasks.
* Present the first practical automation / process-improvement recommendations.

* Deliver reliable recurring reporting to the owner.
* Show improved visibility into AR aging, invoicing status, and upcoming payables.
* Complete at least two meaningful workflow improvements that reduce manual rework or missed follow-up.
* Deliver a prioritized next-step plan for stronger controls, reporting, and sensible use of AI.

**What success looks like**

* Success is not just “the books are entered.” The right person makes the financial side of the business feel organized, current, and visible. Invoices go out on time, collections are handled professionally and consistently, vendor obligations are clear, records are easy to find, and the owner can see what needs attention without chasing information.

Qualifications

* At least 3 years of relevant hands-on accounting/finance-office experience.
* Recent hands-on experience with QuickBooks and the end-to-end cycle of invoicing, AR/collections, AP, vendor bills, and financial organization—not only one narrow task in a large department.
* QuickBooks Online, Excel, bank/credit-card reconciliation, billing, receivables, collections, payables, and basic reporting.
* Experience in a small owner-led B2B business such as distribution, industrial supply, logistics, field service, construction supply, equipment rental/repair, manufacturing support, or a similar operational environment.
* A practical, privacy-conscious use of AI and automation. The candidate should be able to name specific workflows improved with AI or automation and explain how they protected customer and financial information.
* Comfortable making courteous but firm collections calls and documenting commitments.
* A demonstrated record of identifying a problem, creating a usable process, following through, and communicating clearly with an owner, customers, vendors, and teammates.
* The person must want to work in the office five days per week and have a realistic commute.

No CPA or bachelor’s degree is required if the person can demonstrate the actual skills, judgment, and ownership required for the job. A bookkeeping or QuickBooks certification is a plus, not a substitute for proven work.

Compensation and Benefits

* $52,000–$58,000, depending on proven ownership of the full workflow and the ability to improve systems.
* Benefits: Share the current company benefits summary with qualified candidates; do not promise benefits, paid time off, or retirement terms beyond the company’s actual plan documents.

* Review required administrative records, operational reports, and program documentation for accuracy, completeness, and timely submission.

**About Ballpark Music:**  
Ballpark Music (BPM) specializes in producing large-scale postgame concerts in stadiums across the country. BPM handles booking and producing concerts for teams that engage fans, boost attendance and enhance the bottom line of the event. Since inception in 2015, BPM has produced nearly 400 concerts on stadium fields with artists like Chris Stapleton, Snoop Dogg, Zac Brown Band, Marshmello, Thomas Rhett, Weezer, Run DMC, The Avett Brothers, T-Pain, Diplo, Old Dominion, Ludacris, Sam Hunt, AJR, Jordan Davis, Riley Green, Nelly and many, many more. BPM has also handled the on-field production for MLB’s All-Star Week (2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), as well as trophy presentations for the ALCS, NLCS and World Series since 2017.  
  
**Job Summary:**  
We are seeking a talented and driven individual to join Ballpark Music. This person will be directly assisting the President of BPM in all areas including, but not limited to, artist management communications, presenting concert ideas to teams, contract negotiations, maintaining schedules and organized event planning, office management, company HR needs, paperwork coordination, and any activities that keep the company, and the President, running smoothly and efficiently. You will also be responsible for managing all marketing efforts related to upcoming concerts in collaboration with the BPM clients and artists. You will be tracking and coordinating all promotional assets to ensure successful marketing campaigns are being executed. You will also be on site for each show, ensuring a positive relationship with both the Teams and the Artists.  
  
**Job Responsibilities:**  

* Support the President of BPM with all concert preparation, execution and day-to-day operations
* Coordinate with clients & artist management to track, gather, and approve all necessary assets for concert promotion
* Act as the primary point of contact for all marketing assets for BPM clients
* Help implement strategic marketing plans for upcoming concerts to maximize audience engagement and ticket sales
* Stay up to date with industry trends and best practices in both the sports and entertainment sectors to identify new marketing opportunities
* Act as the point of contact for non-technical elements for shows including, but not limited to, coordinating catering, hospitality, crew calls, hotel arrangements, flights, ground, stagehands, techs, show logistics and the show itself
* No job too big, no job too small – this position, like everyone at BPM, will be involved in every facet of planning and executing each show. You will be involved in high level conceptualization of creating world-class events as well as making sure crews have water on site and everything in-between.

  
**Job Skills & Qualifications:**  

* Amazing personal skills and relationship building
* Excellent organizational, oral, and written communication skills
* Bachelor’s degree. Preferably in marketing, business, music production, or sports-related disciplines
* 2+ years of applicable experience with a team, agency or in concert production
* The ability to travel as needed – heavy travel from May to October
* Lift up to 30lbs and be able to stand for long periods of time

unforgettable concert experiences and enhancing the intersection of sports and  
entertainment! Please note that this job description is a general overview and may, and

needs.

new_jobs.description:
**Catering Sales Representative – Join GYRO GYRO DUNWOODY!**
------------------------------------------------------------

At GYRO GYRO DUNWOODY, located in the heart of Dunwoody, GA, we’re passionate about serving up delicious Mediterranean flavors and creating memorable dining experiences. Now, we’re looking for a part-time **Catering Sales Representative** to help us grow our catering business by building strong relationships with local organizations and turning first-time customers into loyal regulars. If you’re a go-getter with a knack for sales and a love for food, we’d love to hear from you!

### **Responsibilities**

As our Catering Sales Representative, you’ll focus on connecting with local offices, schools, churches, teams, and other organizations to grow our catering business. Here’s what your day-to-day will look like:

* Build and manage a list of potential customers by making calls, sending emails, visiting locations, and hosting tastings.
* Quote orders from our price list, close deals, and ensure all order details—like headcount, allergies, timing, and setup—are accurate before handing them off to the kitchen.
* Personally follow up with every new client after their first order and be on-site for big first-time setups.
* Maintain relationships with existing accounts by checking in monthly and encouraging repeat orders.
* Regularly review your sales pipeline and progress with the owner.

This role is all about finding new customers, winning their trust, and keeping them coming back, so you’ll spend your time building relationships—not packing pans or handling deliveries.

### **Qualifications**

We’re looking for someone with:

* **1+ year of experience** in B2B sales, catering or event sales, or account management with named clients.
* A proven track record of finding new customers and generating your own leads.
* A valid driver’s license and an insured vehicle.
* Availability to work **15–20 hours per week** on weekdays.

Bonus points if you have:

* Existing contacts at offices, schools, or organizations in Dunwoody, Perimeter, Sandy Springs, or Doraville.
* Experience in the restaurant or catering industry.
* Familiarity with CRM tools or ezCater.

### **Pay**

We offer a competitive pay structure:

* **$20/hour** base pay.
* **15% commission** on every new account’s first order.
* **5% commission** on reorders for the first 12 months, with additional performance-based tiers for accounts beyond 12 months.
* Quarterly bonuses for hitting growth and retention goals.

This is a part-time role with no cap on commission, so your success depends on the relationships you build and the accounts you grow.

### **How to Apply**

Ready to join our team? Apply through this posting and, in **two or three sentences**, tell us about one customer you won and how you did it. We’re excited to hear your story!

At Gyro Gyro, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, including veterans and military spouses. Let’s grow something delicious together!

***We are looking for a Counter Sales Associate to join our growing team!***

At PDI, our goal is to always be committed to providing quality products with prompt, efficient, courteous service in all segments of our business. We pride ourselves in keeping flexibility of procedures and policy at the forefront so that customer needs are always satisfied.

Since 1973, we have maintained our position as a leader in the wholesale distribution industry and offer first-class service to customers in the residential and commercial plumbing industries, as well as home builders, interior designers, re-modelers, and homeowners. We operate 19 branch locations and 13 showrooms throughout Georgia, Tennessee, and South Carolina.

**Function**: As a Counter Sales Associate, your primary responsibility is to assist customers with their product inquiries, process orders, and provide exceptional service at the sales counter. You will serve as the main point of contact for walk-in customers, contractors, and plumbers, ensuring their needs are met and contributing to the overall sales and profitability of the branch.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Greet customers as they arrive at the counter, assess their needs, and provide product recommendations and solutions based on their requirements. Answer inquiries about product availability, specifications, pricing, and application, providing accurate and detailed information to assist customers in making purchasing decisions.
* Process sales orders, quotes, and invoices accurately and efficiently using the company's order entry system. Verify product availability, pricing, and discounts, and confirm order details with customers to ensure accuracy and satisfaction.
* Develop a comprehensive understanding of the company's product offerings, including plumbing fixtures, fittings, pipes, valves, and accessories. Stay informed about new products, promotions, and industry trends to effectively educate customers and promote sales opportunities.
* Identify opportunities to cross-sell or upsell related products and accessories to customers based on their needs and preferences. Recommend complementary items, upgrades, or alternative solutions to maximize sales and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Provide friendly, professional, and responsive service to all customers, addressing their inquiries, concerns, and requests in a timely and courteous manner. Resolve customer complaints or issues promptly and escalate complex issues to the appropriate supervisor or manager for resolution.
* Assist with order fulfillment processes, including picking, packing, and staging orders for customer pickup or delivery. Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams to ensure timely and accurate order fulfillment and minimize order processing errors or delays.
* Process cash, credit card, and check transactions accurately and securely, following established cash handling procedures and protocols. Balance cash register at the end of each shift and reconcile any discrepancies with supervisor or manager oversight.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment at the counter area, adhering to company policies, safety regulations, and industry standards. Follow proper procedures for handling hazardous materials, maintaining equipment, and ensuring workplace safety for employees and customers.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues in sales, customer service, warehouse, and management to meet customer needs, resolve issues, and achieve sales targets. Communicate product availability, customer feedback, and sales opportunities to relevant team members to support overall branch success.

**Principle Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Previous experience in sales, customer service, or counter sales, preferably in the plumbing wholesale industry.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and establish positive relationships with customers.
* Excellent product knowledge and understanding of plumbing materials, fixtures, and equipment.
* Proficiency in computer skills, including POS systems, order entry software, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
* Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and quality in all aspects of work.
* Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional service and exceeding customer expectations.

new_jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator 2
new_jobs.description:
**Department**

BSD CCC - Network Oncology Research Support

**About the Department**

The University of Chicago Comprehensive Cancer Center (UCCCC) is an integral component of the Biological Sciences Division (BSD). The BSD is the largest of four Divisions of the University and includes the Pritzker School of Medicine. UCCCC administers four established scientific programs, and the NCI-sponsored Cancer Center Support Grant funds ten Shared Resources. The Comprehensive Cancer Center comprises over 190 faculty members from twenty departments, with members currently being awarded over $47 million in total direct costs in peer-reviewed cancer research grants, and $28 million in non-peer-reviewed grants and contracts. The activities of the Center are broad and varied, including research, training and education, communications, fundraising, marketing, clinical trials management, and community outreach.  
  
UCCCC has one of the largest cancer clinical trials programs in the country and in the Chicago area, with nearly 500 adult and pediatric therapeutic trials actively accruing patients. Many of these studies are investigator-initiated, including Phase I or I/II trials, demonstrating UCCCC's commitment to translating basic research findings to the clinic through proof-of-principle and early-phase studies. UCCCC opens over 250 new trials each year and accrues approximately 900 participants to therapeutic trials each year.

**Job Summary**

The Clinical Research Coordinator 2 (CRC2) is a specialized researcher partnering with the clinical Principal Investigator (PI) and under the direction of a departmental or lab research manager. While the Principal Investigator is primarily responsible for the overall design, conduct, and management of the clinical trial, the CRC2 supports, facilitates and coordinates independently the daily clinical trial activities and plays a critical role in the conduct of the study. By performing these duties with limited supervision and/or guidance, the CRC2 works with the PI, department, sponsor, and institution to support and provide guidance on the administration of the compliance, financial, personnel and other related aspects of the clinical study.

**Responsibilities**

* Manages all aspects of conducting clinical trials including screening, enrollment, subject follow-up, completion of the case report form, and adverse event reports.
* Recruits and interviews potential study patients with guidance from PI and other clinical research staff.
* Collects, processes, ships and stores specimens to appropriate laboratory according to established aseptic techniques.
* Identifies and explains the responsibilities of principal investigators, research team members, sponsors, contract research organizations (CROs), and regulatory authorities related to the conduct of a clinical trial.
* Coordinates the conduct of the study from startup through closeout including recruitment and screening of study subjects, obtaining informed consent, collecting research data, and ensuring protocol adherence.
* Plans and coordinates patient schedule for study procedures, return visits, and study treatment schedules.
* Educates patients about study procedures to be performed, visit schedule, what to report between and during visits, and the risks and benefits of the procedures.
* Performs assessments at visits and monitors for adverse events.
* Organizes and attends site visits from sponsors and other relevant study meetings.
* Protects patients and data confidentiality by ensuring security of research data and personal health information and compliance with federal regulations and sponsor protocols.
* Ensures Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) are implemented and documented in accordance to study sponsor, primary investigator, and regulatory agency specifications.
* Maintains accurate and complete records which may include, but are not limited to, signed informed consent, relevant IRB approvals, source documentation, Case Report Forms (CRF's), drug dispensing logs, and study related communication.
* Understands the IRB submission and review process and when and how to apply for IRB review, including facilitation of study initiation through meticulous and timely preparation of IRB submissions independently.
* Ensures compliance with federal regulations and institutional policies.
* May prepare and maintain protocol submissions and revisions.
* May assist in the training of new or backup coordinators.
* Assists with various professional, organizational, and operational tasks under moderate supervision.
* Facilitates and participates in the daily activities of moderately complex clinical studies and performs various activities including patient data retrieval, documenting clinical research records, and participation in program audits.
* Uses knowledge of clinical studies to coordinate the collection of analyzable clinical research data and/or sampleswith a limited to moderate degree of independence. Contributes to the problem solving on assigned clinical research studies and tasks.
* Performs other related work as needed.

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Education:**

Minimum requirements include a college or university degree in related field.

**Work Experience:**

Minimum requirements include knowledge and skills developed through 2-5 years of work experience in a related job discipline.

**Certifications:**

**-**

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Education:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in a related field.

* Analyze customer transportation spend, shipment activity, service performance, pricing, and account trends to identify risks, opportunities for improvement, and areas for increased profitability.
* Prepare and present customer reporting, including transportation spend, service performance, operational metrics, and other account-related information.
* Conduct regular customer meetings, including Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), to evaluate account performance, address concerns, and identify improvement opportunities.

**You may not know our name, but you know our products. What we make is part the places where we live, work and play – all day, everyday.**

Zekelman is a family of companies — 100% domestic manufacturers — with a legacy dating back to 1877. We’re proud to be the largest independent steel pipe and tube manufacturer in North America and the leading innovator in multi-family housing development.

**We believe in what we build and what we build, builds the world around us. Hospitals, hotels, schools, bridges, airports and more.**

**Come build a career you believe in.**

**About the Role**
------------------

As an **Outside Sales Representative**, you will drive business growth within an assigned territory by developing new opportunities, expanding customer relationships, and delivering solutions that meet customer needs.

You will work directly with distributors, fabricators, contractors, engineering firms, and other customers to provide product education, technical support, quotations, and sales guidance. You will also monitor market activity, develop accurate forecasts, and collaborate with inside sales and cross-functional teams to maximize revenue and margin opportunities.

This role is ideal for a motivated sales professional who is comfortable working independently, building long-term customer relationships, and traveling frequently throughout an assigned territory.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Proactively develop and grow business with distributors, companies, fabricators, contractors, engineering firms, and other prospective customers.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships through regular communication, field visits, and industry networking.
* Serve as the primary customer contact for quotations, negotiations, and follow-up throughout the sales cycle.
* Provide customers with product education, training, and technical support.
* Generate leads, identify customer needs, close sales, and support long-term account growth.
* Gather and communicate timely market intelligence, industry trends, customer activity, and competitive information.
* Develop and maintain accurate sales forecasts that align with customer demand and Company objectives.
* Collaborate with inside sales and cross-functional teams to maximize revenue, margin, and growth opportunities.
* Identify potential business opportunities, including emerging markets, new product lines, and possible acquisitions.
* Meet or exceed established sales goals, including revenue, margin, and account-growth objectives.
* Represent the Company professionally at trade shows, industry events, customer meetings, and networking opportunities.
* Quickly identify and address product quality concerns in coordination with the Quality Assurance team.
* Promote safe work practices and maintain compliance with Company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
* At least five years of outside sales experience, preferably within the steel pipe industry.
* Knowledge of steel pipe products is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to generate leads, close sales, and drive revenue growth.
* Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
* Ability to analyze sales trends, market dynamics, competitive activity, and customer needs.
* Strategic and proactive approach to identifying opportunities and solving problems.
* Ability to manage an assigned territory, prioritize competing demands, and work effectively with minimal supervision.
* Ability to build productive relationships with customers and internal business partners.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment.
* Willing and able to travel frequently throughout the assigned territory.
* Able to work independently in a remote, self-directed environment while maintaining strong collaboration with internal teams.

**What You’ll Get**
-------------------

We offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and professional development.

* Competitive base salary
* Sales incentive and bonus opportunities
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) plan with Company match
* Tuition assistance
* Paid vacation and holidays
* Employee recognition and loyalty programs
* Opportunities for continued professional growth and development

**Work Environment**
--------------------

This is a **remote, territory-based position** that requires frequent travel for customer meetings, field visits, trade shows, and industry events. The Outside Sales Representative must be able to manage the assigned territory independently while maintaining consistent communication and collaboration with internal teams.

**Location/Territory:** To be determined  
**Travel:** Frequent travel required  
**Work Arrangement:** Remote and territory-based

Zekelman Industries offers competitive compensation and excellent benefits, including low-cost, high-quality medical and dental benefits. In addition, we have an amazing tuition assistance program, a bonus plan, a 401(k) plan with a generous company match, immediate vesting, and much more.

M/F/D/V

We are Zekelman Industries.

We manufacture superior quality tubular and related products, and provide outstanding service for our valued customers.

We seek to continuously advance the skills and opportunities of our employees, utilizing the latest technology and management tools available to consistently increase profitability and the enterprise value of Zekelman Industries and of our customers.

new_jobs.title: Maintenance Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**WeDriveU** is the leader in shared mobility solutions that connect communities, campuses, and workplaces. WeDriveU operates private shuttle and public transit systems across the U.S serving millions of passenger journeys a year. The company's 5,500+ team members operate 4,000 vehicles across 55 U.S. locations, providing safe, reliable and sustainable options as part of a global family of brands serving more than 1 billion bus and rail passengers on four continents. Visit wedriveu.com to learn more about our company, clients and career opportunities.

**Position Summary**

WeDriveU is seeking a detail-oriented Maintenance Operations Coordinator to support the daily administrative and operational functions of our fleet maintenance department. This role maintains accurate maintenance records, manages work orders in Maximo, coordinates parts and inventory activities, and supports communication between Maintenance and Operations. The ideal candidate has a working understanding of automotive or fleet maintenance operations, strong organizational skills, and experience managing maintenance information and administrative processes. This is primarily an administrative position and does not involve routine hands-on vehicle repairs.

**Responsibilities**

MAINTENANCE SYSTEMS AND WORK ORDER MANAGEMENT

* Open, update, track, and close maintenance work orders in Maximo, keeping information accurate and complete.
* Enter and maintain repair information, labor details, parts usage, and related documentation.
* Monitor outstanding work orders and coordinate with maintenance personnel for timely updates and completion.
* Maintain accurate vehicle maintenance histories, service records, and supporting documentation.
* Help maintain vehicle asset information in Maximo so records reflect the current fleet at the assigned location.

MAINTENANCE ADMINISTRATION AND COORDINATION

* Support the daily administrative activities of the Maintenance Department.
* Coordinate with Operations to help schedule vehicles for preventive maintenance, inspections, and repairs.
* Facilitate communication between maintenance technicians, supervisors, vendors, and operational personnel.
* Organize and maintain maintenance records, inspection documents, invoices, and other departmental files.
* Assist maintenance leadership with administrative follow-up, documentation, and departmental priorities.

PARTS AND INVENTORY ADMINISTRATION

* Request and process quotations for maintenance parts, supplies, and outside services.
* Prepare parts and inventory requisitions for purchase order processing.
* Receive and record parts and inventory transactions in Maximo.
* Assist with tracking inventory records and reconciling discrepancies.
* Coordinate with maintenance personnel and vendors on parts orders, deliveries, and documentation.

PROCESS IMPROVEMENT, TECHNOLOGY AND AUTOMATION

* Identify opportunities to improve and automate maintenance and administrative processes to increase efficiency, effectiveness, and quality.
* Help eliminate unnecessary administrative steps, duplicate data entry, and repetitive manual tasks.
* Use company-approved AI and digital tools to streamline maintenance coordination, reporting, documentation, and follow-up activities.
* Assist with developing practical solutions that simplify workflows and improve the accuracy and timeliness of maintenance information.
* Work with maintenance leadership to identify operational challenges and recommend process improvements.
* Support the implementation of new tools, automated workflows, and improved administrative procedures.

REPORTING AND RECORD ACCURACY

* Generate maintenance reports and provide information requested by maintenance leadership.
* Monitor work order records and identify missing, incomplete, or inaccurate information.
* Support accurate tracking of maintenance activities, preventive maintenance schedules, and vehicle service histories.
* Help maintain records needed for internal reviews, audits, and applicable maintenance compliance requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes, documentation accuracy, and maintenance system use.

**Qualifications**

REQUIRED

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Previous experience in automotive service, fleet maintenance administration, maintenance coordination, or a related environment.
* Working knowledge of automotive or fleet maintenance terminology, repair processes, and maintenance operations.
* Experience with computerized recordkeeping, work order systems, or maintenance management software.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with maintenance technicians, operations personnel, and management.

PREFERRED

* Experience using IBM Maximo or a comparable computerized maintenance management system (CMMS).
* Experience in commercial fleet maintenance, transportation, automotive dealerships, or vehicle service operations.
* Familiarity with preventive maintenance programs, parts inventory, and maintenance reporting.
* Experience supporting maintenance recordkeeping, documentation reviews, or audit preparation.
* Technical training or coursework in automotive technology, fleet maintenance, or a related discipline.

ADDITIONAL EXPECTATIONS

* Maintain accurate, confidential departmental records.
* Follow established company policies, procedures, and safety requirements.
* Maintain an organized, professional work environment.
* Demonstrate accountability for the accuracy and timeliness of assigned work.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**We Offer**

Physical Health

* Exceptional Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance benefits

Financial Health

* Competitive compensation packages
* 401(k) with 4% employer match
* Financial Wellness Tool
* Commuter Benefits

Emotional Health

new_jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO - Northbrook (Part-Time)
new_jobs.description:
**Reports to (title):** CEO

**Job Summary:**

The Executive Assistant to the CEO is responsible for managing administration for the Executive office. Duties primarily include scheduling and managing calendars, meeting and retreat coordination, agency record-keeping, business travel arrangements, and lay leader, donor and volunteer relations. This position provides direct support to the CEO, Leadership Team, Board of Directors and Women’s Board.

**Key areas of responsibility:**

* Provide a high level of collaborative professional support to the CEO using independent judgment and discretion to ensure optimal workflow and
  + Coordinate meetings, phone calls and other external engagements based on understanding of CEO and agency goals.
  + Anticipate and create materials needed for meetings and presentations led and attended by CEO.
  + Develop relationships with executive office peers to effectuate timely responses to meeting requests.
  + Manage logistics, timelines and calendars to ensure the most effective use of the CEO’s time and focus; proactively monitor schedules to identify and resolve conflicts and inefficiencies.
  + Update and maintain CEO contact list.
  + Process and file expense reports.
* In addition to dedicated support for the CEO, provide professional support to Senior Leadership Team as needed.
  + Maintain administrative systems and processes for the Senior Leadership Team.
  + Manage scheduling for all meetings where CEO is present and also when involving key external stakeholders.
  + Handle all aspects of out-of-town executive travel; manage out-of-town visitor travel and hotel arrangements, coordinating schedules as needed.
* Responsible for all aspects of Board and Executive Committee Meetings, including but not limited to: meeting invitations, room reservations and set-up, reminders and attendance, nameplates, catering, meeting materials, taking and distributing minutes.
* Serve as a resource to the Women’s Board providing administrative assistancefor on-site meeting.
* Manage the production and distribution of a wide variety of correspondence and materials with a high degree of sophistication, timeliness, accuracy and confidentiality.
* Responsible for maintaining Contacts and External Address Books

**Key Essential Job Duties/Physical Duties:**

* Ability to sit for long periods of time (up to 4 hours).
* Repetitive movement of arms and hands to operate computer, keyboard and mouse.
* Ability to operate equipment such as phone, computer keyboard, calculator and standard office equipment.
* Vision: must be able to distinguish between colors, shades and brightness with ability to focus.
* Repetitive physical ability to stand up and assist clientele and vendors with all building entrance, as well as all doors.
* Lift/move children up to 40 lbs and carry them to safety in an emergency.
* React with physical and mental alertness in emergency situations and assist in evacuation of building.

**Days/Hours/%Travel:**

Monday-Friday 9:00am-5:00pm coverage on a part-time basis, up to 20 hours per week. Flexibility in being in office and remote.

**Direct Reports (titles and FTE%):**

N/A

**Indirect Reports (titles and FTE%)**

N/A

**Job Category:**

Management

**Hourly Rate:**

$35-$45

**Education Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree

**Previous Experience:**

* 7+ years of progressive responsibilities providing executive level administrative support; experience working with a Board of Directors is preferred.

**Other Requirements:**

* Demonstrated proficiency in Windows PC applications (including MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and/or Prezi, Teams) with the ability to learn other technology as needed.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, along with editing and proofreading aptitude.
* Demonstrated ability to manage new administrative systems and processes for the CEO and Leadership Team.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, projects and display flexibility in a fast-paced and changing work environment.
* Strong organizational and analytical skills, sound judgment, with attention to detail and an intuitive and proactive approach to support.
* A keen sense of urgency, adaptability, accountability, and the ability to strive for excellence in high pressure situations in order to plan and accomplish goals.
* An innovative thinker with the ability to operate both independently and collaboratively.
* Demonstrated aptitude to comprehend directions to perform assignments with minimal supervision.
* Demonstrated mastery of professional office equipment and functions.
* Must have the ability and willingness to shift time/location to coincide with CEO’s needs.
* Ability to maintain the highest degree of confidentiality.

***Employee Benefits:***

*The Hecktman Family JCCs of Chicago offers a suite of comprehensive benefits to full-time staff including:*

* *Flexible Work Schedule*
* *Health, dental, and vision insurance*
* *Participation in a 401(K) plan with matching contributions*

* *Generous paid time off, sick time, and paid observance of secular and Jewish religious holidays*
